news.Title: 〈陸股盤後〉中國10月經濟成長全面走弱 三大指數走低
news.Content:
中國股市A股三大指數周一（16日）同步走低，中國10月經濟成長全面走弱，消費與工業生產均不如預期，投資更意外惡化，顯示北京當局近期推出的刺激措施尚未對實體經濟產生實質帶動效果。

上證指數周一收報3,602.57點，跌0.87%。深證成指收報10,690.78點，跌2.53%。創業板指收報2,320.02點，跌4.37%。

中國10月零售銷售較一年前成長0.4%，增幅不如9月的1.1%，也遜於經濟學家預期的0.8%。工業生產增長4.8%，升幅比9月的5.5%小。

10月工業生產年增4.8%，不如經濟學家預期的5.3%，增速亦較9月放緩。

2026年前10個月固定資產投資較去年同期下降8.1%，降幅大於經濟學家原估的7%；1至9月投資降幅則為7.2%。

今年1～10月份，全國城鎮調查失業率平均值為5.2%，與上年同期持平。10月全國城鎮調查失業率為5.1%，比上月下降0.1個百分點。

不過，許多經濟學家認為，官方失業率未能完整反映就業市場實況，理由是這項統計並未納入失業後返鄉農民工。

中國國家統計局說，總的來看，10月國民經濟總體平穩，延續動能向新、結構向優的發展態勢。但也要看到，國際環境不穩定不確定因素較多，國內供強需弱仍較突出，部分企業生產經營困難，經濟穩中向好基礎還需鞏固。

然而，《彭博》指出，這些數據勾勒出中國經濟正失去動能的前景。北京當局於9月底加大穩增長力道，政府官員推出一套溫和刺激方案，內容包括房貸補貼、擴大公共舉債額度，以及加快推出提振投資措施。

如果經濟進一步失去動能，決策者可能會更加依賴財政政策工具。在借貸需求本就疲軟的情況下，中國人民銀行（央行）已經釋出對降息持謹慎態度的信號。

隨著市場對全球人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮能否持續的疑慮日益升溫，這種對外需的依賴正演變成更大風險——正是這股AI熱潮帶動海外對中國電子產品及其他製造業商品的需求。一旦中國出口放緩，國內消費與投資必須扛起支撐經濟重任的壓力勢必倍增。

news.Title: 台股重挫2635點想抄底？元大投信：過去20年99%股票輸0050
news.Content:
2026年初截至11月13日止，外資在台股集中市場累計賣超逼近3兆元，市場震盪讓許多散戶心慌，元大投信今（16）日表示，過去 20 年來，台灣上市櫃股票中有高達99%都跑輸國民 ETF「元大台灣50（0050）」，能連續兩個十年打敗大盤的個股僅剩 1%，與其天天在股海殺進殺出煩惱選股，不如直接擁抱「台灣隊」。

元大投信指出，台灣當前的資金環境也相當充沛，預估今年台灣「超額儲蓄」有機會來到 8.5 兆元，明年甚至上看 11 兆元。雖然超額儲蓄（GDP 減去消費與投資後的剩餘資金）不能直接等同於「尚未進場的股市資金」，但足以顯示民間資金極為豐沛。從近期台股這兩、三週的修正就能看出內資韌性：儘管外資持續賣超，台灣散戶大軍仍紛紛逢低進場布局；光看近一個月，國人投入 ETF 的資金就將近 1 兆元新台幣，充分展現市場充裕的資金動能。

對照美股與台股的籌碼結構演變，50 年前的美股跟過去的台股很像，散戶比重高達60%以上，法人僅占 30%多；經過半世紀的轉型，如今美股的法人持股比重已來到約58%至60%。不論哪個國家，法人比重越高的市場，長期走勢通常越穩健健康。而在美國資本市場轉型的過程中，ETF 扮演了關鍵角色，目前美國 ETF 規模已達16兆美元，為美股提供了源源不絕的長期投資活水。

觀察台股的三大法人持股變化，有三個重點值得投資人關注。第一是法人占比提升，三大法人持有台股市值的比重，已從過去的 30% 多提升到最新的 50% 以上，市場籌碼結構更趨健康；第二是外資賣超不必過度恐慌，市場近期熱議外資今年賣超台股已達 3 兆元新台幣，但換個角度看，外資持有台股的總市值從年初至今其實大增了 25兆元新台幣，代表外資在台股賺了大錢，這3兆元只是針對獲利部位進行資產再平衡與獲利了結，整體持股水位依然很高；第三則是內資投信強勢撐盤，如同美國有 ETF 撐盤，台灣現在也有龐大的投信資金，背後來源正是國人熱衷買進的 ETF，推動台股資本市場走在更健康的軌道上。

「既然看好台灣的成長性，最簡單直接的參與方式就是投資元大台灣50（0050）。」元大投信表示，觀察 0050 自成立以來的累積報酬率走勢，中間雖然歷經多次黑天鵝與金融海嘯，但長期依然向上，這帶給投資人三個重要啟示。首先，看對市場、怕選錯股就直接買大盤，0050 追蹤台灣市值前 50 大企業，買進等於自動網羅各時代的產業龍頭，從早期的傳產走向科技、從亞洲走向全球、從代工組裝走向 AI，完整見證台灣產業升級史，加上成分股會定期自動汰弱留強，投資人完全不用煩惱換股問題。

其次，投資不能沒有台積電，但也不能只有台積電，買 0050 就是一次投資整個「台灣隊」，而台積電就是台灣隊的隊長。最後，別為了躲避股災而錯過複利，投資人總想精準避開金融海嘯，卻往往因此錯過長期複利的威力，與其空手等待股災，不如透過定期定額等方式及早參與、長期留在市場，自然能獲得合理的報酬。

元大投信也提醒，0050 在 2003 年成立後，若一路抱到 2008 年遇到次級房貸風暴，單筆投資滿 6 年其實仍處於虧損，當時許多人因此感到失望，這正說明了長期投資不能只用一、兩年，甚至五、六年的短期眼光來看待。

針對部分投資人疑問「個股漲得比較兇，何必買 0050？」，元大投信引用台灣上市櫃所有股票與 0050 的總報酬率回測數據指出，在第一個十年（2003 至 2013 年）僅有 18% 的個股績效贏過 0050，代表高達 82% 的股票輸給大盤。

到了第2個十年（2013 至 2023 年），贏過 0050 的個股更降至 11%，高達 89% 輸給大盤；若橫跨二十年（2003 至 2023 年）來看，能夠連續兩個十年都打敗 0050 的個股只剩下約 1%。因此，若不想在股海裡殺進殺出、每天煩惱選股，只想穩健參與台股成長，0050 就是最快速有效的選擇。

元大投信強調，0050 如今已不只是單純的投資工具，更是長壽社會下退休規劃的最佳解方；甚至在台灣，現在政府針對新生兒與育兒家庭都有提供津貼補助，父母從孩子一出生開始，就能善用這筆資金定期投入 0050，為下一代提早累積第一桶金。

news.Title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Entegris, Ultra Clean and FormFactor
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – November 16, 2026 – Zacks.com announces the list of stocks featured in the Analyst Blog. Every day the Zacks Equity Research analysts discuss the latest news and events impacting stocks and the financial markets. Stocks recently featured in the blog include: Entegris Inc. ENTG, Ultra Clean Holdings Inc. UCTT and FormFactor Inc. FORM.

Here are highlights from Monday's Analyst Blog:

Buy 3 AI Semiconductor Equipment Stocks to Tap Huge Market Opportunity

The global semiconductor manufacturing equipment and materials industry is growing by leaps and bounds, buoyed by artificial intelligence (AI)-driven capital expenditure in leading-edge logic, high-bandwidth memory ("HBM") and Test and Packaging components.

On July 14, SEMI reported in its Mid-Year Total Semiconductor Equipment Forecast – OEM Perspective that the market size of this industry is expected to reach a record high of $165.9 billion globally in 2026, up 23.2% year over year. The momentum is set to continue in the near term, reaching an estimated $229.5 billion globally in 2028.

Here, we recommend three stocks from this space for investment to reap benefits from a potentially vast market. These companies are: Entegris Inc. , Ultra Clean Holdings Inc. and FormFactor Inc.

Each of our picks currently carries either a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) or 2 (Buy). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank stocks here .

Entegris Inc.

Zacks Rank #1 Entegris serves materials, contamination control, equipment and fab construction applications, allowing growth across different phases of semiconductor investment.

AI-related investment supports ENTG's materials and purity products across advanced logic, memory and packaging. Advanced logic represents about 40% of revenues and memory about 30%. In the third quarter of 2026, ENTG secured a 2-nanometer EUV filtration application, an advanced materials plan of record with a major technology provider and multiple CMP wins with memory customers.

ENTG's margin progress reflects strong execution and mix. Adjusted gross margin reached 48.9% in the third quarter of 2026, up from 43.6% a year earlier and 47.6% in the second quarter. Adjusted operating margin increased to 26.8% from 21.1%, while adjusted EBITDA margin rose to 30.2% from 27.3% year-ago. APS adjusted segment margin reached 34.4%.

Strong Guidance

For the fourth quarter of 2026, Entegris expects revenues between $1.025 billion and $1.055 billion, implying about 26% year-over-year growth at the midpoint. GAAP earnings are projected at $1.09-$1.17 per share, while non-GAAP earnings are forecast in the range of $1.32-$1.40.

Story Continues

Management projects an adjusted gross margin of 49.2%-49.7% and an adjusted EBITDA margin of 30.7%-31.2%. Non-GAAP operating expenses are anticipated between $224 million and $230 million. ENTG expects approximately $200 million in capital expenditures for 2026, down from the earlier $250 million plan.

Solid Estimate Revisions

Entegris has an expected revenue and earnings growth rate of 17% and 58.6%, respectively, for the current year. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year's earnings has improved 10.9% over the past 30 days.

ENTG has an expected revenue and earnings growth rate of 14.3% and 28.1%, respectively, for the next year. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for next year's earnings has improved 12.7% over the past 30 days.

Ultra Clean Holdings Inc.

Zacks Rank #2 Ultra Clean reported solid third-quarter 2026 results and its outlook benefits from rising semiconductor equipment demand as AI investment expands across foundry, logic and memory.

UCTT is benefiting from semiconductor capital equipment investment tied to AI infrastructure, with demand broadening across foundry, logic and memory. Leading-edge foundries are expanding capacity for advanced nodes, while memory manufacturers are investing in DRAM, high-bandwidth memory and advanced packaging.

Ultra Clean's UCT 3.0 strategy aims to capture this growth through additional manufacturing capacity and higher-value engineered solutions. UCTT's outsourced model, capacity growth and closer customer design work support share gains. Higher utilization and a richer mix of engineered subsystems offer room for margin expansion. Services should add higher-margin revenue as new fabs increase wafer starts.

For the fourth quarter of 2026, Ultra Clean expects revenues between $800 million and $860 million. The midpoint implies sequential revenue growth of approximately 9.4%. UCTT projects non-GAAP earnings per share between $1.11 and $1.35, based on around 48.9 million diluted shares. GAAP earnings per share are expected between $1.02 and $1.26.

Ultra Clean has an expected revenue and earnings growth rate of 34.8% and more than 100%, respectively, for the current year. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year's earnings has improved 11.8% over the past 30 days.

UCTT has an expected revenue and earnings growth rate of 36.8% and 95%, respectively, for the next year. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for next year's earnings has improved 0.6% over the past 30 days.

FormFactor Inc.

Zacks Rank #1 FormFactor is benefiting from robust growth in HBM driven by the rapid adoption of generative AI and high-performance computing. FORM's advanced packaging continues to raise test complexity in DRAM, particularly as HBM evolves toward faster interfaces. Third-quarter 2026 DRAM revenues held near the second-quarter record at $84.9 million despite a shift from HBM to DDR5.

FormFactor's SmartMatrix technology supports testing of completed HBM4 stacks at speeds above 10 gigabits per second. Management expects HBM growth to continue through 2027, citing its HBM4E and HBM5 design pipeline and differentiated final-stack test capability.

FORM's co-packaged optics (CPO) is moving toward production and expanding the Systems opportunity. Systems revenue reached a record $59.5 million in third-quarter 2026, up 23% sequentially, on higher TRITON photonics system demand. Management raised its 2026 TRITON revenue expectation to upwards of $30 million from the initial $10 million to $20 million range.

FORM also serves near-package optics and pluggable applications through wafer-level photonic integrated circuit testing. Its integrated Keystone optical probing technology broadens exposure as customers adopt different photonics architectures.

For the fourth quarter of 2026, FormFactor expects revenues of $285 million, plus or minus $10 million, reflecting continued broad-based demand. Non-GAAP gross margin is projected at 54%, plus or minus 150 basis points. Non-GAAP earnings are expected to be 95 cents per share, plus or minus 9 cents.

At the midpoint of its fourth-quarter outlook, FORM expects 2026 revenues to exceed $1 billion for the first time. The company continues to target a longer-term operating model of $1.6 billion in revenues, 55% gross margin and $5 in non-GAAP earnings per share.

FormFactor has an expected revenue and earnings growth rate of 33% and more than 100%, respectively, for the current year. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year's earnings has improved 9.2% over the past 30 days.

FORM has an expected revenue and earnings growth rate of 21.7% and 29.9%, respectively, for the next year. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for next year's earnings has improved 15.9% over the past 30 days.

news.Title: 台股才狂飆6000點就翻臉！專家：早有人看出不對勁「3大警訊早已浮現」
news.Content: 台股今（16）日遭遇史詩級賣壓，加權指數開低走低，終場重挫2635.04點，收在41040.08點，跌幅達6.03%，成交金額8450.56億元，不僅失守4萬2000點，更 創下台股史上第二大單日收盤跌點紀錄。 面對市場再度陷入恐慌， 財經專家葉育碩 回頭檢視上週分享的 分析師陳嘉偉（嘎偉老蘇） 觀點，當時台股才剛從低檔強彈逾6000點，但嘎偉已提醒反彈量能不足、個股跟漲有限，甚至示警可能回測年線。他認為，這次重挫再次提醒投資人，市場不能只聽多方聲音，尤其手中持股越多，越應該正視空方提出的風險。 【台股暴跌2635點：改寫史上第二大收盤跌點】 台股今天開盤即面臨沉重賣壓，加權指數以43512.42點開出，隨後一路走低，最低來到41040.08點，終場也收在最低點，單日下跌2635.04點，跌幅6.03%，成交金額達8450.56億元。 這次跌點超越2025年4月7日關稅戰期間的2065.87點，成為台股史上第二大單日收盤跌點，僅次於2026年7月17日的2953.71點。 【反彈逾6000點就示警：嘎偉老蘇當時點出3大隱憂】 葉育碩表示，上週回頭看自己分享的陳嘉偉分析師「嘎偉老蘇」觀點，當時台股才剛經歷連續幾天強勁反彈，短短幾個交易日就大漲6000多點，多頭氣勢相當旺盛。 不過，嘎偉當時已經提出幾項值得注意的警訊。 第一，指數雖然反彈強勁，但成交量卻一天比一天少， 代表追價力道可能沒有表面上那麼強，這種缺乏量能支撐的反彈，後續能否延續仍有疑問。 第二，許多個股根本沒有跟上大盤漲勢， 例如環球晶（6488）、國巨（2327），當時股價甚至連10日線都還碰不到。換句話說，指數看起來漲得漂亮，但不少投資人的持股卻沒有實際感受到反彈。 第三，嘎偉認為， 這波急漲可能已經接近反彈滿足點 ，接下來必須留意指數回測年線，甚至不排除再次破底的可能。 此外，嘎偉在直播中也提醒，年線第一次觸及後出現反彈，不代表行情已經結束修正，後續仍要觀察市場籌碼是否真正沉澱。 【多頭氣氛太旺：空方警訊反而沒人想聽】 葉育碩指出，當時市場正處於一片樂觀氣氛，指數短短幾天大漲6000多點，多數投資人沉浸在反彈行情中，自然不太想聽到空方提出的看法。然而，今天台股重挫逾2600點，再回頭檢視當時的分析，至少可以發現，嘎偉所提醒的風險並沒有憑空消失。 不過，葉育碩也強調，今天的大跌不代表嘎偉先前提出的每一項預測都已經完全獲得驗證，更不代表接下來行情一定會按照原先預測發展。

news.Title: 台股重挫及外資賣超壓力，新台幣兌美元週一貶值4.8分，收32.886元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】台北外匯市場週一新台幣兌美元匯價走貶，美元指數週一亞洲盤持穩於近期高點附近，亞洲主要貨幣升貶互見，日、韓元盤中升值，台幣匯價表現相對疲軟，同時，科技股抛售潮再起拖累亞股，台股集中和店頭市場雙雙重挫逾6%，外資賣超上市股票701.89億元，也不利台幣匯價行情。新台幣兌美元匯率週一以32.886元作收，與前一交易日比較，台幣匯率貶值4.8分。銀行間新台幣兌美元最高成交價為32.870元，最低成交價為32.969元，成交量為17億2,200萬美元。

高盛發佈的2027年宏觀展望報告稱，預期台灣央行將在2027年上半年進行三次12.5個基點的升息，將終端政策利率推升至2.375%；到2027年第四季，隨著聯準會降息，美台利差將縮窄至1.75%。同時，預期台灣經常帳盈餘佔GDP比例2026年將達到24%的歷史新高。

高盛這份報告指稱，自2025年第二季台幣升值以來，離岸存款、貸款及應收款項急速增加，累積達到GDP的11.5%，顯示台灣出口商未來有充裕的資金匯回空間。此外，預期2027年台灣主要科技大廠因應薪資、稅收與股利發放所需的台幣年增需求高達GDP的1.4%。

news.Title: Zacks.com featured highlights include Ralph Lauren, Expedia, NVIDIA and Lam Research
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – November 16, 2026 – Stocks in this week's article are Ralph Lauren RL, Expedia Group EXPE, NVIDIA NVDA and Lam Research LRCX

4 GARP Stocks That Investors Can Scoop Up for Maximum Returns

If you are looking for a profitable portfolio of stocks offering the best of value and growth investing, you can try the growth at a reasonable price or GARP strategy.

The strategy helps investors gain exposure to undervalued stocks with impressive prospects. Unlike a blend strategy, a portfolio that uses GARP investing is expected to include stocks that offer the best of value and growth investing. Ralph Lauren , Expedia Group , NVIDIA and Lam Research are some GARP stocks that hold promise.

GARP Metrics: Mix of Growth & Value Metrics

The GARP strategy seeks to offer an ideal investment by utilizing the best features of value and growth investing. Investors adopting the GARP approach prefer buying stocks priced below the market or any reasonable target determined by fundamental analysis. These stocks also have solid prospects in terms of cash flow, revenues, earnings per share (EPS) and so on.

Growth Metrics

A strong earnings growth history and impressive earnings prospects are the main concepts that GARP investors borrow from the growth investing strategy. However, instead of super-normal growth rates, pursuing stocks with a more stable and reasonable growth rate is a tactic of GARP investors. Hence, growth rates between 10% and 20% are considered ideal under the GARP strategy.

Another metric that growth and GARP investors consider is return on equity (ROE). GARP investors look for a strong and higher ROE than the industry average to identify superior stocks. Stocks with positive cash flows take precedence under the GARP plan.

Value Metrics

GARP investing prioritizes popular value metrics, the price-to-earnings (P/E) and price-to-book (P/B) ratios. Though this investing style picks stocks with higher P/E ratios than value investors, it avoids companies with extremely high P/E ratios.

Using the GARP principle, we ran a screen to identify stocks that should offer solid returns in the near term.

Here are four stocks from the 15 that made it through the screening process.

Expedia Group entered the holiday quarter with raised full-year guidance, a key near-term stock catalyst. The company now projects 2026 gross bookings of $131.4-$131.9 billion, revenues of $16.37-$16.43 billion and adjusted EBITDA margin expansion of 1.8-2 points. The fourth-quarter guidance calls for revenues of $3.69-$3.75 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $830-$880 million. Product momentum supports demand.

Story Continues

The Fall 2026 release added more than 30 new and enhanced features, including AI Compare, Activity Planner and Vrbo's AI Voice Agent. In B2B, the Rapid Activities API, enhanced by Tiqets inventory, entered beta, with general availability planned for early 2027. Tiqets activities also reached select UK travel agencies through Expedia TAAP in beta. A $0.48 quarterly dividend, to be paid out on Dec. 10, supports ongoing shareholder returns.

The consensus estimate for EXPE's 2026 earnings has moved north by 0.9% to $20.84 per share in the past 60 days. This Zacks Rank #1 company surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate in each of the trailing four quarters, with the average surprise being 15.26%.

Ralph Lauren entered the holiday season with raised fiscal 2027 guidance, constant-currency revenue growth centered around 6% to 7% on a 52-week basis, and operating margin expansion of 80 to 100 basis points. Third-quarter growth is guided to be 3% to 4%, including about one point of drag from wholesale timing and off-price reductions.

Its Asia initiatives include the Japan app launch and Polofest in Tokyo, the first activation ahead of the brand's 60th anniversary in 2027. Inventory is down 9% year over year, and $500 million of repurchases completed fiscal 2027 buyback plans, alongside a $1 quarterly dividend. Tariff uncertainty and softer European comparable sales remain risks, while leadership realignments effective Nov. 29 aim to sharpen execution across operations, product and AI.

The consensus estimate for RL's fiscal 2027 earnings per share has moved south by 0.3% to $18.72 in the past 60 days. This Zacks Rank #2 company surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate in the trailing four quarters, the average surprise being 8.44%.

NVIDIA 's near-term setup rests on guidance and product ramps. Management projects third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenues of $108 billion, plus or minus 2%, with gross margin near 74.0%, while assuming no China Data Center compute revenues. Vera Rubin, in full production, is running at cloud partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure.

In October, NVIDIA's MGX 1.2 rack specification added support for deployments up to 250kW, and Meta is adopting Spectrum-6 Ethernet switches. In September, NVIDIA launched an open agent-safety platform, and the board added $150 billion to the buyback authorization, leaving $235 billion. Leadership is the swing factor. Jensen Huang's Nov. 12 resignation makes CFO Colette Kress interim CEO, though the board expects roadmap continuity.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for NVDA's fiscal 2027 earnings per share has moved south by 3.4% to $9.28 in the past 60 days. This Zacks Rank #2 company surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate in all four trailing quarters, the average surprise being 5.82%.

Lam Research 's near-term setup rests on guidance and capacity readiness. Its December-quarter guidance calls for revenues of $8.6 billion, plus or minus $400 million, with non-GAAP gross margin of 52.5% and EPS of $2.33, plus or minus 15 cents. Management links demand to AI-driven device complexity. The Oct. 27 imec collaboration targets 3D integration and Aether dry resist for high-NA EUV patterning, broadening technology relevance.

The company also expects to outgrow wafer fabrication equipment spending. A new 470,000-square-foot Livermore logistics hub, retrieving parts in under 30 seconds, should help the company respond to demand shifts. Capital return, which includes a $25 billion repurchase authorization and a $0.33 quarterly dividend, to be paid out on Jan. 6, 2027, adds support. Execution against guidance, however, remains the key variable.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for LRCX's fiscal 2027 earnings has moved north by 3% to $9.60 per share in the past 60 days. This Zacks Rank #2 company surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate in all four trailing quarters, the average surprise being 6.43%.

news.Title: AI慘綠台股自高點急挫12%！法人看好歐日股抗震 多元布局成避風港
news.Content:
近期AI科技話題不斷引發市場震盪，投資人荷包大縮水。摩根投信指出，隨著市場重新檢視AI龐大資本支出的投資回報，造成金融波動加劇。統計全球金融市場自10月6日急速修正以來，台股急跌12.34%，日本TOPIX指數跌幅僅5.78%，歐洲STOXX 600指數更逆勢上漲4.49%，並於11月12日再創歷史新高，凸顯全球分散配置的重要性。

這波市場震央發生在AI及高估值科技股。摩根日本鑫收益主動式ETF及摩根歐洲鑫收益主動式ETF經理人吳昱聰表示，那斯達克100指數下跌10.47%，標普500指數下跌3.20%。相較之下，歐洲股市涵蓋金融、能源與醫療等價值型產業，日本產業結構也相對分散，在市場重新關注價值型股票之際，展現不同於科技股的投資機會。

歐洲股市近期表現亮眼，STOXX 600指數再創歷史新高。產品經理黃百嵩補充，支撐歐股關鍵除產業多元外，還包括企業獲利改善與能源價格回落。德意志銀行預測歐洲企業利潤增速可達25%，有助緩解企業成本壓力。此外，歐洲國防、基礎建設及AI相關投資持續推進，亦為中長期成長增添動能。

news.Title: 台股暴跌2635點！郭哲榮喊「錯殺」：點名這9檔逢低布局
news.Content:
台股今（16）日遭遇重挫，接連失守4萬3與4萬2千點大關，終場大跌 2,635.04 點，收在 41,040.08 點，跌幅 6.03%，並創下台股史上第 2 大跌點紀錄，成交金額為新台幣 8,450.56 億元。面對輝達創辦人黃仁勳離職風波延燒與新平台供應鏈傳聞， 摩爾投顧投資長郭哲榮（哲哲） 卻認為，市場恐慌情緒已經過度反應，這波下跌反而出現錯殺機會，強調AI長線需求並未改變，並點名精材（3374）、帆宣（6196）、智原（3035）、聯發科（2454）等個股，喊話手上還有現金的投資人可以把握低檔布局機會。

【AI需求依舊火熱！H100租金反漲六成成鐵證】

針對週末過後利空擴大，市場傳出輝達（NVIDIA）新一代Vera Rubin平台供應出現瓶頸、放量恐延至明年，導致高階材料與光通訊族群短線承壓。郭哲榮分析，目前主力GB300仍持續交貨，市場將單一供應鏈雜音過度放大，實屬多慮。

他進一步引述戴爾（Dell）創辦人最新貼文指出，輝達H100晶片租金竟比一年前高出近六成；同時，外媒《彭博》報導AI新創Anthropic公開發行認購需求高達發售股數約六倍。郭哲榮強調，舊晶片租金逆勢上揚與機構法人搶購AI新創，皆證明算力供需依舊吃緊，看好AI的基礎並未動搖。至於連署人數突破15萬人的黃仁勳，他認為仍有一定機率回歸輝達。

【無懼大盤重挫！點名精材、帆宣等9檔潛力股】

在個股佈局上，郭哲榮認為多檔績優股受大盤拖累而遭低估，逢低反而是絕佳買點：

封測與廠務工程 ：精材（3374）今日雖打入跌停，但測試產能較去年底大增約五成，第四季新產能與光感測器新專案放量，後市仍有機會挑戰新高；帆宣（6196）今日下跌約7%，受惠台積電核准大筆資本預算，先進製程與封裝建廠商機持續發酵，整理後有望再攻。

ASIC與IC設計 ：智原（3035）早盤一度漲逾7%後受大盤拖累拉回，但2奈米雲端AI大案預計明年貢獻營收；聯發科（2454）今日跌逾5%，首款AI加速器已出貨且第二家ASIC客戶到手，雲端大廠自研晶片將成另一條成長引擎。

矽晶圓族群 ： 環球晶（6488） 、中美晶（5483） 與 台勝科（3532）今日跌幅較深。環球晶已表態既有12吋產能滿載、部分客戶願提前加價，明年供需將更為緊俏，短線下跌純屬盤勢影響。

被動元件 ：國巨（2327）重挫逾7%跌至3字頭、華新科（2492）打入跌停。國巨有大客戶長約保供貨，華新科則積極轉向高階產品，題材並未結束，國巨跌至3字頭價位極具吸引力。

news.Title: 《台股盤後》收跌2635點、史上第二大跌點，日K連三黑
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-16 15:44:56 新聞中心 發佈

上週五費半指數重挫與今(16)日NASDAQ電子盤續跌壓力下，台股今(16)日創意盤初即跌停，拖累欣興、台達電、南亞、台光電、奇鋐接連跌停，同時台積電、聯發科跌勢也不斷加重，導致早盤強勢的長榮、中信金、中華電等權值股也轉弱下，導致市場對國安基金盤中的拉抬效應抱持觀望、反而擔憂台指期週三的空方結算壓力，加權指數終場收在41040.08點，下跌2635.04點或6.03%、摜破200日線並創收盤史上第二大跌點，日K連三黑、成交量約8450.56億元。

美國最新PPI數據未改變市場對FED進一步升息的預期，同時輝達前景不確性仍高、拖累上週五費半指數收跌3.4%，美股四大指數也僅DOW JONES小紅。亞洲股市方面，NASDAQ電子盤僅盤初反彈不久後即翻黑，進一步拖累半導體相關股走勢，日經225指數終場下跌2.42%；韓股因三星電子、SK海力士下挫，KOSPI指數終場下跌3.59%。

台股今日市場賣壓沉重，在上週五費半指數走跌、今日NASDAQ電子盤翻黑影響下，投資人情緒明顯偏向保守；電子族群普遍走弱，台積電收在2215元，下跌5.74%，創意、大立光、台光電、欣興、健策、奇鋐、台達電都跌停，南亞科、川湖、鴻勁、鴻海、智邦、國巨*等也都重挫逾9%，聯發科跌近8%，日月光投控、緯穎、聯電、廣達等跌勢亦重。

從盤面表現來看，多數類股承受壓力，玻璃陶瓷類股下跌9.67%，表現最弱；電子零組件也有9.42%的跌幅，且有多檔個股跌停，包含臻鼎-KY、金像電、華新科、禾伸堂、台光電、聯茂、健鼎、南電、台虹等；塑膠股下跌8.65%、光電股下跌8.37%、其他電子股跌8.35%，跌勢也不輕。不過，仍有少數族群逆勢抗跌，其中表現最佳的三大類股分別為居家生活上漲1.09%，資訊服務股上漲0.54%，以及運動休閒股上漲0.52%。

三大法人動向方面，今日三大法人總計賣超1140.55億元；其中，外資及陸資(不含外資自營商)賣超701.89億元，投信賣超179.62億元，自營商賣超259.03億元。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》新式核能—OKLO、LEU、CEG
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-16 15:40:24 數位內容中心 發佈

Oklo（OKLO.US）

11月，Oklo與Centrus簽署正式多年期高含量低濃縮鈾（HALEU）供應合約，燃料自2029年開始交付，足以支援最多5座Aurora powerhouses。這份合約對應俄亥俄州1.2GW園區第一階段，且由Meta預付未來用電款支持採購。

Centrus Energy（LEU.US）

11月，Centrus把與Oklo的HALEU合作推進為正式供應合約，交付自2029年啟動，對應最多5座Aurora powerhouses。公司並揭露新建產能累積的LEU與HALEU客戶合約與承諾總額已達54億美元，合約期間延伸至2040年。

X-energy（XE.US）

11月12日，X-energy揭露德州Long Mott Generating Station已取得美國核能管理委員會（NRC）施工許可。這一案同時是美國近60年來首個高溫氣冷式反應爐施工許可，也是首個先進核能工業部署案施工許可，代表Xe-100已從設計推進到施工節點。

Constellation Energy（CEG.US）

11月，Constellation揭露與Google合作將支撐11座核電機組投資，為PJM電網增加約890MW增量容量，首次擴容預計於2028年實現。公司並已與美國能源部簽署最高50億美元條件式貸款承諾，用於多座核電廠擴容。

Fluor（FLR.US）

11月，Fluor獲X-energy選定，將為華盛頓州Cascade Advanced Energy Facility提供核島工程、設計與供應鏈服務。該案首期部署4座Xe-100、合計320MW，顯示Fluor已切入先進核能專案的實際工程執行與供應鏈整備階段。

NuScale Power（SMR.US）

10月29日，NuScale選定Doosan Enerbility製造首個商業化電力模組的上部反應器冷卻劑系統。公司並表示已建立超過60家專業供應商關係，且多數料件正推動雙來源或第三來源配置，反映供應鏈已由設計走向製造準備。

GE Vernova（GEV.US）

11月，Ontario Power Generation表示安大略省GE Vernova Hitachi小型模組化反應爐（SMR）專案可能無法達成原訂2030年10月投運目標。首座機組容量300MW，初始總預算約54億美元，反映北美SMR首案仍面臨工期與成本壓力。

Lightbridge（LTBR.US）

8月，Lightbridge入選美國能源部（DOE）的Nuclear Energy Launch Pad INL計畫，推進SHED燃料試量產工廠授權路徑。同月公司也與Battelle Energy Alliance簽署任務聲明，推進富集鈾-鋯燃料rodlets包殼照射試驗。

news.Title: 統一期貨：台股開低走低一路重挫，權值股走弱，PCB族群成重災區

news.Title: 永豐期貨：輝達估值下修！台股重挫2635點、跌停84家
news.Content:
【財訊快報／編輯部】指數週一下跌2635.04點，收在41040.08點，成交量0.89兆元。台指期下跌3058點至40781點，逆價差為-259.08點。籌碼面部分，三大法人賣超1140.55億元；而在台指期淨部位方面，三大法人淨空單減少496口至-3222口，其中外資淨空單減少4083口至-96787口；十大交易人中的特定法人全月份台指期淨多單減少8141口至5029口。多家券商近期接連下修輝達目標價，FactSet最新調查顯示目標價中位數由300美元降至281美元，台股今日開低走低。早盤開在43,512點，該價位即為全日最高，開盤後賣壓一路湧現，指數全場幾乎沒有反彈，終場重挫2,635點(-6.03%)，收在全日最低點41,040點。今日成交量8,451億元。盤面上下跌家數1,182家(其中跌停84家)，遠多於上漲143家。

個股表現上，前波主流股的龍頭同步摜上跌停，ASIC指標創意(3443)、PCB指標台光電(2383)、ABF載板指標欣興(3037)、散熱指標奇鋐(3017)、玻纖布指標南亞(1303)、記憶體指標南亞科(2408)與台達電(2308)全數跌停。AI伺服器供應鏈同樣重挫，鴻海(2317)狂瀉9.34%，日月光投控(3711)狂瀉8.03%，聯發科(2454)狂瀉7.89%，AI伺服器指標緯穎(6669)狂瀉7.34%，台積電(2330)重挫5.74%、收在2,215元。金融股也未能倖免，富邦金(2881)重挫5.88%，元大金(2885)重挫5.50%，台新新光金(2887)重挫5.16%，國泰金(2882)跌3.93%；全場只剩中華電(2412)小跌0.91%相對抗跌。

整體來看，今日是這波回檔以來最重的一天，跌停84家比11/5的56家又多出一截，指數跌點也是這波最大，上週國安基金與限空令帶動的近4,000點反彈，今天一天就回吐了六成以上。這次的壓力來自AI龍頭的評價重估，輝達目標價接連遭到下修，台股的AI供應鏈從晶片到組裝整條鏈一起被賣，加上上週大漲累積了不少獲利籌碼，前波漲幅最大的主流股成了最先被賣的位置。前幾次殺盤中還能撐住的金融股，今天也重挫逾5%，盤面只剩中華電接近平盤。量能則比前一交易日略為收斂，低檔並沒有出現承接買盤。後續可留意18日清晨公布的輝達財報，以及同一天台指期結算前後的籌碼變化。

news.Title: 外資上周賣超台股近千億卻狂敲主動式ETF 00403A最受青睞
news.Content: 台股上周加權指數單周上漲10.1%，但從籌碼面來看，三大法人合計仍站在賣方，其中外資賣超近千億元。不過，觀察上市外資近五日買超排行可以發現，外資在調節個股之際，卻轉而買進主動式ETF，其中統一升級50(00403A-TW)最受青睞，居外資單周買超之冠。 統計近五個交易日，外資合計賣超台股約967.9億元，同時卻回補主動式ETF，其中買超力道最強的就是統一00403A，累計獲外資買超達24.78萬張。其他外資近五日上市買超排行第二至第五名，則依序為：台玻(1802-TW)24.72萬張、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)23.00萬張、主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)21.23萬張，以及華航(2610-TW)13.45萬張。 拉長時間觀察，近三個月台股在國際利空消息衝擊下震盪加劇，指數走勢起伏明顯，市場觀望氣氛濃厚，外資卻不畏市場風雨，持續加碼00403A，近三個月累計買超金額達158億元。反觀同樣名列外資近五日買超前五名的00406A，近三個月累計遭外資賣超97億元，買盤的延續性則有待觀察。 統一投信投研團隊表示，近期台股隨美股走弱，在美國選後AI政策不確定性、AI產業消息面及股市籌碼面等因素干擾下，市場情緒偏向恐慌，盤勢波動劇烈，短線預料仍將維持震盪格局。 不過，統一投信投研團隊進一步指出，待融資去化、恐慌性賣壓獲得釋放後，走勢可望回歸基本面。AI產業基本面依然穩健，雖然受政策影響，部分需求可能遞延，但並未消失。美國新政策的重點，在於避免讓居民分攤資料中心建設所需的電力、水資源及相關基礎設施成本，隨著大型雲端服務商陸續表態願意吸收相關成本，政治面的疑慮可望逐步緩解。 外資上市近五日買超排行前五名 股票名稱 外資近五日 買超張數（萬張） 外資近三個月 買賣超金額（億元） 00403A 主動統一升級50 24.78

news.Title: Walmart, Target, Amazon, Nvidia, Micron and Alphabet are part of Zacks Earnings Preview
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – November 16 2026 – Zacks.com releases the list of companies likely to issue earnings surprises. This week's list includes Walmart WMT, Target TGT, Amazon AMZN, Nvidia NVDA, Micron MU and Alphabet GOOGL.

Walmart, Target & NVIDIA Headline a Pivotal Week for Q3 Earnings

Walmart shares have seen a modest bid in recent weeks, likely reflecting the company's defensive attributes as the more glamorous AI trade has lost some of its earlier luster. Despite recent struggles, Walmart shares outperformed peers like Target and even Amazon over the last five years, up more than +175% vs. +49.7% for Amazon and -27.8% for Target. Walmart's +175% gain over the last five years compares to a +79% gain for the S&P 500 index.

Unlike this standout performance over the last five years, Walmart shares seem to have lost their mojo this year, even though they seem to be rebounding lately.

Walmart shares were down sharply after the last quarterly release on August 20th, reflecting a combination of factors, including a seemingly lower-quality earnings beat (benefiting from tariff refunds), decelerating comp growth, and underwhelming Q3 guidance.

It will be interesting to see whether Thursday, November 19th's quarterly release helps the stock build on its recovery. We should keep in mind that we will have seen results from Target ahead of Walmart's release, with Target reporting results before the market's open on Wednesday, November 18th. As we saw in the performance chart above, Target shares have been enjoying a strong market run, outperforming Walmart and the broader market by a mile.

Walmart and other big-box retailers are undoubtedly facing a difficult operating environment, with elevated fuel costs adding to consumers' financial burdens and increasing retailers' expenses. These macro overhangs partly accounted for management's softish guidance for Q3.

It is important to keep in mind that Walmart shares command a premium valuation, trading currently at 40.1X forward 12-month EPS estimates, only modestly below the 10-year high valuation multiple of 45.4X in February 2026. This represents a significant expansion in the valuation premium relative to Target.

Market participants expect stocks commanding premium valuation multiples to beat-and-raise when they report results, which is not what we saw from Walmart.

Despite the negative effects of elevated fuel costs on consumer spending and the company's freight costs, Walmart remains better positioned than many others in the space given its value orientation, greater indexing to groceries, and robust digital capabilities. Walmart has been consistently gaining market share among higher-income households in recent years, which has more than offset affordability-based demand softness from its lower-income consumers.

Story Continues

Walmart is expected to report $0.64 in EPS on $186.5 billion in revenues, representing year-over-year changes of +3.2% and +3.9%, respectively. For same-store sales, the expectation is U.S. comps (ex fuel) of +2.89%, compared to a +2.6% gain in the preceding quarter (vs. expectations of +3.07%) and a +4.5% gain in the year-earlier period (vs. expectations of +3.96%).

The expectation for Target on the comps front is +3.16% growth, following the +3.8% gain in the preceding period (vs. expectations of 2.54%). Target's impressive comp showing in the August 19th release followed a similarly impressive result on May 2nd. Given the stock's recent momentum, Target investors are likely looking for a repeat performance this week.

With respect to the Retail sector 2026 Q3 earnings season scorecard , we now have results from 17 of the 30 retailers in the S&P 500 index. Regular readers know that Zacks has a dedicated stand-alone economic sector for retail, unlike its placement in the Consumer Staples and Consumer Discretionary sectors in the Standard & Poor's standard industry classification.

The Zacks Retail sector includes not only Walmart, Target, and other traditional retailers, but also online vendors likeAmazon and restaurant players. The 17 Zacks Retail companies in the S&P 500 index that have already reported Q3 results mostly belong to the e-commerce and restaurant industries, though we have several restaurant companies on deck to report this week as well.

Total Q3 earnings for these 13 retailers that have reported are up +2.8% from the same period last year on +10.7% higher revenues, with 70.6% beating EPS estimates and 52.9% beating revenue estimates.

The revenue beats percentages for these online players and restaurant operators are tracking significantly below the historical averages for this group of companies, but EPS beats are far more numerous.

With respect to earnings and revenue growth rates at this stage, we like to show the group's performance with and without Amazon, whose results are among the 17 companies that have already reported. As we know, Amazon's Q3 earnings were down -2.4% on +12.1% higher revenues, as it missed both EPS and top- line expectations.

Earnings for the group outside of Amazon are up +11% on a +9.1% top-line gain.

Q3 Earnings Season Scorecard

Through Friday, November 13th, we have seen Q3 results from 454 S&P 500 members, or 90.8% of the index's total membership. Total earnings for these companies are up +24.9% from the same period last year on +13.7% higher revenues, with 82.4% beating EPS estimates and 75.1% beating revenues estimates.

Excluding the Micron and Alphabet contributions, Q3 earnings for the remaining index members that have reported would be up +21.7%.

The comparison charts below show the Q3 EPS and revenue beats percentages for these companies compared to other recent periods.

The Earnings Big Picture

Looking at Q3 as a whole, combining the actual results from the 454 S&P 500 members with estimates for the still-to-come companies, total earnings are on track to increase by +28.9% from the same period last year on +14.6% higher revenues.

As you can see above, index earnings are expected to increase by +27.9% from the same period last year, on +13.5% higher revenues in the current period (2026 Q4).

The revisions trend has been positive, as we have repeatedly noted in recent weeks.

We should note that the magnitude of positive revisions we are seeing for Q4 is weaker than what we saw in the comparable period for Q3.

Nvidia , Micron and Alphabet have substantial weight in the index's annual earnings growth pace. Nvidia has been in the news lately for all the wrong reasons, but the semiconductor leader is on deck to report Q3 results after the market's close on Tuesday, November 17th.

As we noted earlier, estimates for full-year 2027 are experiencing the same positive and broad-based revisions trend that we noted earlier in the context of 2026 Q4.

For a detailed view of the evolving earnings picture, please check out our weekly Earnings Trends report here >>>> Q3 Earnings Results Reconfirm Broad Based Strength as Outlook Improves

news.Title: 0050失寵？台股史上第二大跌點　ETF成交王是它
news.Content:
輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳辭任後，市場對人工智慧（AI）產業前景產生疑慮，美股費城半導體指數重挫。台股今（16）日賣壓進一步擴大，不僅大型電子權值股全面下殺，ABF載板、印刷電路板（PCB）、測試介面、散熱及高價股同步走弱，盤面跌停家數超過百檔。加權指數終場以最低點作收，重挫2635.04點、跌幅6.03%，收在41040.08點，創歷史第二大收盤跌點。成交值縮減至8450.57億元，日K線收長黑K。台股今日重挫逾2600點，電子權值與AI相關供應鏈全面承壓，後續市場仍將關注美國科技股走勢、AI產業前景，以及台股能否逐步消化短線賣壓。

主動式獲青睞 槓桿反向交投熱

隨台股劇烈震盪，ETF成交量也成為市場關注焦點。根據口袋證券11月16日整理的ETF近五日平均成交量排行榜，前十名涵蓋主動式、槓桿型、反向型、市值型及高股息ETF，其中主動中信台灣收益（00406A）以日均成交84.81萬張居冠，群益臺灣加權正2（00685L）及元大台灣50正2（00631L）分別以72.06萬張、63.66萬張排名第二、第三。

排名第四的主動統一台股增長（00981A）近五日平均成交量38.58萬張，元大台灣50反1（00632R）則以33.58萬張排名第五，顯示市場交易熱度同時集中於主動式、正向槓桿及反向ETF。其餘成交量前第六依序為元大台灣50（0050）31.41萬張、凱基台灣TOP50（009816）24.15萬張、主動統一升級50（00403A）23.06萬張、國泰永續高股息（00878）10.40萬張，以及主動復華未來50（00991A）9.90萬張。ETF近五日成交量排行榜呈現主動式、槓桿型及反向型商品交易熱絡的格局。

成交量月增率揚 受益人數揭殖利

從月增率觀察，主動中信台灣收益達27.53%居前十名之冠；元大台灣50正2為10.67%，群益臺灣加權正2為10.19%，元大台灣50增加5.75%，主動統一台股增長增加4.10%。國泰永續高股息月增率為3.69%，凱基台灣TOP50為1.93%，主動統一升級50為1.03%，主動復華未來50為0.11%；元大台灣50反1則減少4.28%，為榜單中唯一月增率呈現負值的ETF。

受益人數方面，元大台灣50以395萬6621人居冠，國泰永續高股息達177萬4723人，凱基台灣TOP50及主動統一台股增長分別為101萬1837人、101萬132人。其他ETF方面，主動統一升級50受益人數80萬1195人，主動中信台灣收益58萬1020人，元大台灣50正2為39萬3565人，主動復華未來50為32萬1395人，群益臺灣加權正2為23萬7925人，元大台灣50反1則為5萬4655人。殖利率方面，榜單中有揭露近四季殖利率的ETF，以國泰永續高股息9.94%最高，主動中信台灣收益6.99%、主動統一台股增長6.76%、主動復華未來50為5.34%，元大台灣50則為1.56%。

news.Title: 【Follow法人】外資翻臉提款701億元！台積電鴻海失血逾250億元 大砍中鋼逾3萬張居個股之冠
news.Content:
（下午4點40分更新買賣超個股）

台股今（16）日創下史上第二大收盤跌點，三大法人合計賣超台股高達1140.55億元，其中投信終止連24日買超，調節179.63億元，外資則大舉提款701.89億元，ETF淪重災區，值得注意的是，電子代工龍頭鴻海（2317）、權王台積電（2330）兩大電子權值股雖未擠進賣超前十大，仍合計遭提款逾250億元。第一金投顧董事長黃詣庭坦言，「今日盤勢有點過度恐慌了！」相較大盤指數重挫逾6%，外資賣超金額「沒有想像中大」，研判跌勢不僅來自外資調節權值股，也有相當程度是「內資恐慌性的殺盤」。

外資今日賣超前三大：00406A、00403A、00981A

外資今日賣超前10檔標的中有9檔ETF，合計遭賣超逾92萬張，其中主動中信台灣收益（00406A）單日遭砍逾31萬張，成為最大提款標的；主動統一升級50（00403A）遭調節16萬9,644張，排名第二；主動統一台股增長（00981A）則被賣超12萬8,599張，排名第三。

傳產股僅有鋼鐵龍頭中鋼（2002）擠進前十大，遭外資賣超3萬5,680張，排名第九。

值得注意的是，鴻海（2317）雖未擠進外資賣超前十大，仍以2萬8,939張排名第11名，以今日收盤價218.5元估算，外資單日提款金額高達63.23億元。

台積電（2330）同樣遭賣超8,466張，以收盤價2,215元計算，失血約187.52億元，兩大電子權值股合計遭提款逾250億元。

外資今日買超前三大：寶成、台新新光金、00712

反觀外資買超榜，傳產與金融股成為資金青睞的焦點。製鞋大廠寶成（9904）獲外資買超2萬5,106張，高居今日買超冠軍；台新新光金（2887）獲加碼2萬1,167張，排名第二；復華富時不動產（00712）則獲買超1萬6,767張，排名第三，成為今日ETF買超最多的標的。

電子股方面，晶圓代工二哥聯電（2303）獲外資買超1萬5,443張，排名第四，也是唯一擠進買超前十大榜單的電子股。航空雙雄同步獲加碼！四大金控擠進買超榜

航空雙雄也獲外資青睞，長榮航（2618）獲買超1萬3,031張，排名第五；華航（2610）則獲加碼1萬2,932張，排名第六，兩檔航空股合計獲外資買超2萬5,963張，成為今日傳產族群另一大亮點。

外資翻臉提款701億元 投信終止連24買

根據證交所公布籌碼動向，三大法人今日合計賣超1140.55億元。其中，外資賣超701.89億元，呈由買轉賣。

投信賣超179.63億元，終止連24買，同樣呈由買轉賣。

自營商合計賣超259.03億元，其中自行買賣部分買超31.19億元，避險操作賣超290.22億元，同樣呈由買轉賣。

外資淨空單部分，前一交易日為10萬870口，今日則為9萬6,787口，減少4,083口。

美股科技股賣壓延燒，台股今日終場重挫2,635.04點，以全日最低41,040.08點作收，跌幅6.03%，創史上第二大收盤跌點，僅次於今年7月17日的2,953.71點，成交金額8,928.04億元。

三大權值股齊挫，台積電（2330）下跌135元，收在2,215元，跌幅5.74%；聯發科（2454）、鴻海（2317）亦有超過7%、9%跌幅。電子代工、載板、測試介面、散熱及光通訊股均面臨沉重賣壓，千金股更高達17檔亮燈跌停。

投信終止連24買是警訊？關鍵看ETF申贖與規模變化

黃詣庭分析，外資今日順勢減碼大型權值股，除反映輝達後續營運的不確定性，也可能搭配本周三台指期結算前的空單部位操作。他指出，市場關注的已不只是輝達財報數字，更在意暫代執行長克雷斯對既有產品進程、業者融資計畫及供應鏈策略的說明。不過，他認為市場對台廠合作關係可能鬆動的疑慮「是過度擔憂」，因為台灣從AI產業最上游到下游組裝，在方圓數百公里內就能找到完整供應鏈，「我們的供應鏈價值是沒有辦法被取代的」。即使部分產能釋出，也有其他GPU晶片設計商及ASIC業者爭取，只要AI基礎建設持續擴張，中長期對台灣產業的傷害相對有限。

黃詣庭也提到，今日跌勢不能全歸因於外資，因為不僅大型權值股下跌，中小型股賣壓也相當沉重，櫃買市場表現更弱，反映內資有恐慌性調節。上周五已看到投信買超力道下降，部分主要ETF也開始出現資金流出跡象。先前投資人在下跌過程中持續申購ETF，帶動規模增加，投信因而必須買進；但在大盤反彈後，若投資人開始調節ETF部位，使資金由淨申購轉為淨贖回，投信就可能被迫減碼持股。黃詣庭說，初步觀察0050規模仍有增加，顯示仍有投資人逢低承接，加上本周部分大型ETF準備配息，也可能吸引資金流入，「短期資金動向較為複雜」。

市場廣度顯示極端恐懼 反彈優先觀察大型權值股

黃詣庭指出，上周台股反彈主要由少數權值股帶動，並未充分擴及中小型股，今日權值股帶頭下殺，其他個股反而跌得更重。依其觀察，今日站上月線的個股比率僅15.67%，低於上周五約兩成的水準；站上年線的比率也僅約24%，代表市場廣度偏弱，投資心態已呈現「極端恐懼」。

他認為，從多項指標與盤面結構來看，這類極端情緒可能已接近尾聲。自營商自行買賣逆勢加碼，也代表市場仍有資金進行逢低操作。短線若指數展開反彈，建議優先觀察大型上市權值股，並持續追蹤市場廣度，確認上漲能否擴散至更多個股。

news.Content:

Micron Technology（MU.US）

11月14日市場資訊指出，Micron對2027年記憶體產出已有超過75%透過合約被客戶預訂，另有說法指2027財年出貨也已有超過75%完成承諾配置。這次訊號直接連到AI用高頻寬記憶體（HBM）與伺服器動態隨機存取記憶體（DRAM）供應仍偏緊。

SK hynix（SKHY.US）

11月11日報導指出，SK hynix已與14家主要客戶簽署長期合約，通常為5年期，涵蓋2027至2028年超過一半產能。另有報導稱管理層表示，DRAM與HBM到2029年的部分數量已近乎售罄，顯示高密度記憶體配置正明顯前移。

SanDisk（SNDK.US）

11月12日報導顯示，SanDisk客戶正逐步改簽多年期供應協議，納入需求承諾、價格上下限與財務保證。公司同時推進BiCS10，並表示高頻寬快閃記憶體（HBF）首顆記憶體晶粒已完成設計定案並進入製造，預計2027年送樣第一代產品。

Western Digital（WDC.US）

本週與AI儲存相關的最新訊號來自Western Digital的40TBUltraSMR ePMR硬碟進入量產客戶認證階段，且近線儲存交期仍偏長。報導同時指出，若AI軟體效率提升壓低單次部署用量，硬碟每TB成本較企業級固態硬碟（SSD）低6倍至10倍。

Seagate Technology Holdings（STX.US）

11月11日報導提到，市場正關注Seagate的熱輔助磁記錄（HAMR）Mozaic平台，作為提升硬碟容量密度與毛利率的重要產品主軸。另有說法指出，Seagate近線供應的大部分產能已透過長約配置至2028年，反映AI資料湖需求仍在牽動儲存配置。

news.Title: Cisco posts its best growth in 15 years. Why isn't Wall Street buying?
news.Content: When I wrote about Morgan Stanley 's downgrade of Cisco on Nov. 6, one worry was that customers were buying early, ahead of price increases. I know how frustrating an unreliable network can be when you're trying to work, research, or access important information online. Cisco's latest report was the test. It was a strong one. Cisco (CSCO) reported first-quarter revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24%, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.40, up 40%. That was its strongest revenue and earnings growth in more than 15 years. Growth was in double digits across all regions and ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Cisco reported first-quarter revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24%, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.40, up 40%, marking its strongest growth in over 15 years.
• Growth was robust across all regions and customer markets, with AI revenue outlook raised to $9 billion from $7.5 billion, accounting for 60% of the $2.5 billion guidance increase.
• Operating margin reached a record 37.8% due to controlled operating expenses (up 2% vs. 24% revenue growth), with the full-year operating margin outlook raised to 36%.
• Despite strong results, Morgan Stanley maintained an Equal-weight rating and $120 price target, citing moderating enterprise orders and balanced risk/reward.
• The stock is trading at approximately 19 times expected fiscal 2027 earnings, in line with the S&P 500, and is up 24.16% year-to-date.

台股今（16）日再度上演大逃殺！加權指數開低走低，盤中一度狂瀉逾2千點，跌幅超過4%，最低下探41,591點，跌破4萬2，讓不少股民哀號連連。

眼看距離聖誕節還有一個多月，PTT網友卻提前感受到「綠色聖誕節」，有網友苦笑「大家持股都變聖誕樹」，也有人直喊「說好的反彈呢」。李永年表示，台股短線恐持續震盪整理，建議投資人先觀望，今日可留意41,500點支撐，以及國安基金是否進場拉抬尾盤。

李永年指出，今日台股走勢疲弱，除了受到國際股市影響外，市場也受到輝達執行長黃仁勳相關風波衝擊。他認為，相關事件牽涉美國國安、政治等問題，短時間內恐難以解決，預估未來兩至三個月，AI產業仍可能面臨不確定性，台股也不排除持續震盪整理。

至於今日台股能否止跌，李永年表示，接下來可觀察國安基金是否進場拉抬尾盤，若未見明顯護盤動作，恐代表大盤仍有進一步下探的可能。不過，他認為，雖然今日跌勢沉重，但要直接跌破4萬點的機率不高，預估41,500點附近應有支撐。

面對台股重挫，李永年建議，投資人現階段應先觀望，不宜急著進場搶反彈。今日除了留意尾盤是否出現支撐買盤，也應觀察市場賣壓能否逐步消化，等待盤勢較為明朗後，再評估後續操作方向。

news.Title: 高盛看好標普500續漲15% 未來一年挑戰8,700點
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-16 12:04:26 李彥瑾 發佈

近期美國科技股遭遇大幅修正，人工智慧（AI）產業投資前景也浮現疑慮，但知名投行高盛（Goldman Sachs）仍看好美股後市，預估標普500指數未來12個月可望攀升至8,700點，距離11月13日收盤價7561.67點，尚有15.1%上漲空間。

路透社報導，高盛日前發布研究報告指出，近期美股回檔已使股票估值下降，回到相對合理水準，來到具備中長期配置吸引力的區間。隨著美股修正至今，標普500指數未來12個月預估本益比已降至18.5倍，明顯低於先前逾23倍的高點，在估值回落的情況下，正是分批布局的好時機。

不過，高盛分析師預期，面對大型雲端業者AI資本支出成長放緩，2027年全球企業獲利成長率可能「腰斬」，其中美國企業獲利年增幅恐由36%縮水至11%，尤其AI基礎設施相關產業將首當其衝。

高盛指出，即使企業獲利成長趨緩，但基於通膨降溫、債券殖利率回落，加上經濟維持溫和成長，仍有利股市延續漲勢，只是市場波動可能加劇。

區域配置方面，高盛維持美國與日本股市「加碼」（overweight）評等，亞洲與新興市場為「持有」（neutral），歐洲股市則維持「減碼」（underweight）。

news.Title: 台股下殺逾2千點！2大鬼故事爆恐慌 輝達Vera Rubin危機
news.Content:
市場傳出輝達新一代機架級AI運算平台Vera Rubin因高頻寬記憶體HBM供應問題延後放量，使台股盤中跳水重挫超過2000點，整體走勢比日韓更加慘烈，載板、光通訊及電源等多檔指標股被打入跌停，且除了延後放量的消息之外，主機板出現翹曲（Warpage）問題，同樣使大量出貨延至明年上半年。

2大利空強襲 台股慘遭血洗

人工智慧族群遭全面血洗，ABF、PCB、晶片設計、電源散熱、組裝及半導體皆重挫，信驊、創意、台光電、台達電、欣興、南電、景碩、金像電、尖點、大立光、聯亞、波若威、華新科、京元電及台勝科等上市櫃將近70檔慘殺跌停。

主要的利空消息圍繞在輝達Vera Rubin新伺服器延後放量的市場傳聞，高頻寬記憶體存在供應瓶頸，要等到2027年上半年之後才會逐步放量，較預期的2026年底還要晚。

然而，外媒《Newsquawk》引述社群平台X上知名的AI市場研究帳號Jukan的業內消息指，主要問題在於主機板翹曲，影響產品良率與量產進度。Jukan認為，先前的高頻寬記憶體供應問題已解決，與市場上的傳聞有所不同，但皆指向Vera Rubin延後放量。

台股本身籌碼面、技術面挑戰大

目前輝達並未回應相關消息，但台股已率先反應，跌幅超過4%，比日經下跌1.57%，韓股下殺2.69%更為疲弱。目前輝達經營層出現動盪，創辦人黃仁勳因婚外情風暴已在上周辭去總裁兼執行長職務，同時也退出董事會，全面退出第一線，輝達由財務長克瑞斯（Colette Kress）暫代執行長。

台股除了消息面的衝擊，技術面與籌碼面上也有壓力，外資尚未歸隊，融資餘額仍有下降空間，台股反彈超過6000點之後，面臨月季線下彎壓力，以及45K的套牢解套賣壓，顯然需要時間進一步沉澱。

news.Title: 27檔台股ETF本周除息 本波低點反彈11檔表現勝大盤
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-16 11:31:29 新聞中心 發佈

受AI投資回報疑慮、AI監管政策不確定升溫影響，台股近逼5萬點大關後回落，跌至11月6日失守4萬點，跌幅逾20%，隨著盤勢波動加劇，市場焦點轉向兼具績效亮眼、配息穩健兩大優勢的台股ETF。本周有27檔台股ETF即將除息，平均預估年化配息率超過10%，而若進一步觀察這27檔ETF自11/6低點反彈以來的績效，有11檔打敗同期大盤的10.01%，漲勢凌厲。而主動群益台灣強棒（00982A）上漲16.6%，漲幅居冠，本次預估每股配發0.78元，預估年化配息率16.03%，整體表現最佳。

市場法人認為，00982A自掛牌以來已繳出翻倍成長的好成績，今年即使歷經美伊戰爭、貨幣政策不確定性、AI前景疑慮的衝擊，依舊繳出亮眼表現，展現主動式ETF能靈活應變行情、創造超額報酬的優勢。值得一提的是，00982A自首次配息以來，已連續6次配息，更四度提升配息金額，還達成次次填息的驚人紀錄，讓投資人息利雙收。00982A最新預估每股配發0.78元，有意參與領息的投資人，最晚需在11月16日買進，收益分配發放日則在12月11日。

群益投信主動式台股ETF研究團隊表示，儘管本周台股表現回神，大漲逾3000點，外資仍持續賣超，進而限制台股漲幅。不過今、明兩年台股企業獲利年增率上修至65%、30%，顯示台股基本面穩健，並突顯當前台股估值極具吸引力。後續可觀察外資是否歸隊、成交量是否放大，以確認台股能否重回上漲趨勢。綜合來看，台股在具備基本面、評價面兩大優勢下，預期台股多頭格局有望延續，若有回檔，皆是佈局中長線的好時機。

00982A經理人陳沅易指出，AI產業正從算力擴張，進入投資報酬驗證階段，加上主權AI與在地化需求不斷增加，預期在政策面干擾消退後，AI投資仍有機會重回正軌。在AI趨勢未變下，台股AI供應鏈獲利將持續成長，成長動能亦逐步擴散至非AI產業，有利中長期市場表現。操作上，隨AI應用由模型延伸至推論、數位代理人，運算資源需求續提升，將帶動相關設備與廠務工程需求，而具備技術優勢、跨區域服務能力、訂單能見度的供應鏈值得持續關注。

news.Title: 大摩上調2027年標普500指數目標價位至8,700點，看好美股與德英公債
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，在摩根士丹利(大摩)的2027年市場展望中，該行看好美股和部分10國集團(G10)國債。包括Marina Zavolock在內的摩根士丹利策略分析師在標註日期為11月15日的一份報告中寫道，該行已將標普500指數目標價位上調至8,700點，意味著約15%的上升空間。

這份報告指出，穩健的盈利成長、趨於穩定的利率和油價、持續的人工智能投資與應用，以及低於公允價值的估值共同支撐著2027年展望。

摩根士丹利還將日本東證指數目標價位上調至4,800點，相當於約22%的上升空間。這份報告強調，日本廣泛的再通膨、私營部門資本支出週期，以及以股票回購和股息派發形式體現的、有利於公司治理和股東的舉措，這三者形成了積極的交匯。

在利率方面，摩根士丹利看好德國國債和英國國債。包括Matthew Hornbach在內的策略分析師在報告中寫道，市場對2028年英國央行升息的預期高於該行預期，而對歐洲央行寬鬆政策的預期則低於該行預期。

摩根士阿丹利預計美國10年期國債殖利率將維持在5%左右，並預計聯準會將在3月前將利率上調至4.375%的區間中點，並在明年維持該水準。

news.Title: 2巨頭瘋搶TPU！ 郭明錤點名「這台廠」：最後大贏家
news.Content:
受惠OpenAI與Anthropic強勁新訂單，Google TPU出貨能見度已直達2029年，表現優於Nvidia GPU。天風國際證券分析師郭明錤指出，這波AI算力大洗牌中，聯發科拿下v9與v10獨家設計服務大單，無疑成為未來數年最大贏家。

OpenAI與Anthropic大單灌頂

根據郭明錤最新的產業調查與研究結論，受惠於AI服務龍頭OpenAI與Anthropic的強勁新訂單，Google TPU的出貨能見度已延伸至2029年，大幅領先多數落在2027年第四季至2028年第二季的Nvidia GPU與其他AI ASIC。郭明錤分析，自2028年起，v9將成為Google自建算力的主力方案，而v8系列（包含8t、8i或其設計變種）訂單則可視為來自OpenAI與Anthropic的直接需求。在2028至2029年間，OpenAI針對聯發科設計的8t合計需求約12M，採買斷模式；Anthropic對Broadcom設計的8i需求則約14M，採租賃與買斷並行，兩者需求皆呈逐年成長趨勢。考量供應鏈限制後，2027至2029年較合理的TPU整體出貨量預估分別為8–9M、14–15M與16–18M，打破市場普遍認為AI資本支出將於2028年見頂的預期。

通吃未來世代獨家設計

在產品藍圖與供應鏈調整方面，郭明錤透露，Google v10產品線已由原先的Icefish與Merope／Bladerunner改為Quillfish，預計2029年量產，設計服務訂單確定由聯發科取得。原本的Icefish則順延改為v11，預計2030年量產，同樣由聯發科拿下設計服務訂單；至於Merope因能見度較低，供應商尚未確定，未來甚至可能取消。聯發科將成為v9（Humufish & Triggerfish）與v10（Quillfish）的獨家供應商，預估2027至2029年占整體TPU供應比重將逐年攀升，分別達到45～50%、50～55%與55～60%，推升營收與利潤貢獻。此外，自v9起新款TPU均採用Intel EMIB-T先進封裝，但考量初期量產能力，預期至2029年仍以v8系列為出貨主力，憑藉長期累積的學習曲線效益及關鍵零組件與材料採購優勢，v8將是聯發科與Broadcom未來數年TPU事業獲利成長的核心動能。

聯發科成最後大贏家

展望市場熱度與供應商前景，郭明錤認為Nvidia CEO接班的不確定性，有利於Google與客戶洽談2028年後的長期規劃，加上關鍵客戶OpenAI與Anthropic的IPO題材，皆能持續維持Google TPU的市場關注度，而聯發科與Broadcom正是供應鏈的首要焦點。郭明錤直言，「聯發科無疑是未來數年TPU的最大贏家」，不僅身為v9後的獨家設計供應商，供應比重與TPU出貨量更同步逐年成長，搭配高毛利率的8t系列能見度直達2029年，營運規模與獲利可期。另一方面，Broadcom因主導8i設計，毛利率更勝8t，同樣有助利潤成長，但需留意Broadcom未來數年的營運重心已轉向非TPU的XPU與AI網路晶片訂單，預計最快在2027年，其非TPU營收便會正式超越TPU。

news.Content:

訂單優於預期，加上日圓貶值，線性滑軌(LM Guide；Linear Motion Guide)大廠THK獲利飆增、上修今年度財測預估。不過THK今日股價未受提振、暴跌。

截至日本股市16日早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)為止，THK崩跌15.39%、暫收4,630日圓。

THK上週五(13日)於日股盤後公布財報新聞稿指出，因AI需求帶動半導體相關投資擴大，激勵訂單優於原先預期，加上日圓匯率較預期走貶，因此今年度(2026年1-12月)合併營收目標自原先(8月)預估的3,100億日圓上修至3,200億日圓(將年增33.1%)、合併營益目標自480億日圓上修至520億日圓(將年增260.2%)、合併純益目標自548億日圓上修至588億日圓(上年度為淨損698億日圓)。

THK同時公布今年度前三季(2026年1-9月)財報：因訂單持續強勁，日圓走貶，合併營收較去年同期大增34.5%至2,359.39億日圓、合併營益飆增286.6%至377.41億日圓、合併純益狂飆793.2%至469.35億日圓。

就區域別業績來看，1-9月期間THK於日本市場的營收較去年同期增加18.9%至956.02億日圓、營益因認列事業出售獲利而狂飆1,175.9%至337.99億日圓；美洲市場營收下滑16.4%至555.72億日圓、營益增加7.3%至12.87億日圓；歐洲市場營收下滑18.6%至408.20億日圓、營益為2.16億日圓(去年同期為營損15.86億日圓)；中國市場營收暴增41.2%至787.12億日圓、營益飆增113.2%至144.24億日圓。

news.Title: Amazon vs. Target: Which Stock Is the Better Portfolio Addition?
news.Content:
The competition between Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) and Target (NYSE:TGT) highlights two distinct paths for investors. Investing in Amazon is about seeking greater stock price appreciation in the future, while owning Target is more about getting paid today through collecting dividends.

Amazon leverages a massive logistics network and high-margin cloud services to drive growth, while Target focuses on providing a differentiated, multi-category shopping experience. These companies often compete for the same household spending, yet they offer very different financial profiles. Further choosing between them requires understanding their unique strengths and the specific risks they face in an evolving market.

The case for Amazon

Amazon operates a sprawling ecosystem that includes an online store, third-party seller services, and the high-growth AWS cloud computing division. The company serves a diverse range of customers including individual consumers, developers, and government entities through its massive logistics network. By maintaining strategic relationships with millions of vendors, it ensures a constant flow of goods and services across North America and international markets.

In the 12 months ended Sept. 30, 2026, revenue reached nearly $797.5 billion, representing growth of approximately 15.4%. Its net margin was approximately 16.9% as the company generated a net income of roughly $134.8 billion during this same period. This performance highlights the significant scale of its operations as it continues to expand its reach in digital services and advertising.

The case for Target

Target operates as a general merchandise retailer, emphasizing a curated selection of essentials and trend-forward products across nearly 2,000 stores. It thrives by fostering guest relationships and maintaining partnerships with high-profile brands like Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL), Starbucks (NASDAQ:SBUX), and Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA). This strategy is central to its position among retail stocks as it successfully integrates physical locations with digital delivery options.

In the 12 months ended Aug. 1, 2026, revenue was roughly $107.7 billion, showing growth of approximately 2% compared to the prior twelve-month period. Target maintained a net margin of roughly 4.1% and reported a net income of nearly $4.4 billion for this timeframe. While its growth pace is slower than its tech-heavy rival, the retailer remains a vital part of the American consumer landscape.

Risk profile comparison

Amazon faces intense global competition across retail, e-commerce, cloud services, and advertising sectors. The company is subject to evolving government regulations, including antitrust and data privacy laws, which result in ongoing investigations and potential legal costs. Significant operational risks include the complexity of managing a large global fulfillment network and a massive workforce that is critical to its daily operations.

Story Continues

Target faces risks from intense competition and the need to differentiate its guest experience through pricing and assortment. The company is vulnerable to inventory management challenges, including exposure to theft and organized retail crime that can impact profitability. Additionally, it remains highly dependent on U.S. macroeconomic conditions and a global supply chain that is susceptible to geopolitical instability and trade policy changes.

Valuation comparison

Target is cheaper based on its lower forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio and price-to-sales (P/S) ratio, which measures market cap against sales over the past twelve months.

Metric

Amazon

Target

Forward P/E

24.7x

17.4x

P/S ratio

3.6x

0.6x

Which stock is the winner?

Although both serve a retail base, Amazon is much more aligned as a technology company than Target is. In addition, what each stock offers is also notably different.

Amazon may not offer the explosive stock price appreciation of an up-and-coming quantum computing stock . But owning it still depends on what it can do for investors, more so in the future than today. One example is that Amazon reported in its 2026 third-quarter earnings report that 12-month free cash flow turned from a $14.8 billion inflow to a $42.4 billion outflow, thanks largely to spending more on building out artificial intelligence infrastructure. And the important takeaway there is that, with aggressive spending today, Amazon is asking its shareholders to judge its future path more than today's free cash flow. Broadly, owning Amazon is about how big its business could be in five to 10 years.

In comparison, owning Target is more about cash generation today and returning it to shareholders, with its dividend currently yielding 2.8%. Through the first six months of 2026, operating cash flow was $4.5 billion for Target, up from the $2.4 billion it reported in the prior-year period. That gives it plenty of flexibility to invest further in its stores, pay down debt, or have the money flow to dividend payouts. In step with some of the improvements Target is seeing in its financials, the stock price has climbed 65% this year, compared to a 10.4% return for the S&P 500 over the same period. While stock price appreciation typically isn't the main consideration for an income stock, it's helpful to have, because you don't want a decreasing stock price cutting into the returns from those dividend payouts.

Between the two, Amazon's story is more about what it can build itself into, while Target is about improving its current business and passing on what it makes to shareholders through dividend payouts.

news.Title: Morgan Stanley’s Q3 filing reveals $5.6 billion SpaceX stock surprise
news.Content:
The part of the hotly anticipated Nov. 14 SpaceX Starship flight I kept replaying wasn't the launch. It was the exact moment the spacecraft came back from orbit and hung between the steel arms of the same tower it had left the day before.

Needless to say, it was quite the spectacle, and NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman probably said it best, calling it "almost magic." Similarly, Google-parent Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai wrote on X , saying, "Congrats @SpaceX for that starship catch, still feels like science fiction! Watching it live was incredible. Upwards!"

The booster missed its planned catch, so this wasn't a clean sweep. But recovering the ship itself gets SpaceX ( SPCX ) closer to flying it again instead of having to build a new one for every trip.

Just before Starship came home, a Q3 13F filing by Morgan Stanley (one of the bookrunners on SpaceX's June IPO) gave SpaceX investors something remarkably pertinent to look at.

The bank reported a $5.6 billion stake in SpaceX as of the end of the quarter, meaning the position was already on its books well before the catch.

SpaceX stock fell in Q3 but Morgan Stanley's share count nearly tripled

Morgan Stanley reported 37.3 million SpaceX stock shares at the end of September, up from 13.5 million at the end of June, an increase of 23.8 million shares (a whopping 176% jump), as reported by 13F.info .

The position's reported value climbed from roughly $2.3 billion to $5.6 billion, even as SpaceX fell nearly 12% during the quarter, from $170.86 to $150.86.

The case for getting in on the SpaceX action isn't tough to see.

More SpaceX:

SpaceX fires back at T-Mobile over desire to harm Starlink

SpaceX's multi-trillion-dollar case rests on a bet not yet launched

Bank of America sends SpaceX stock investors strong signal

The company's Q3 results showed sales jumping 161% to $14.6 billion, driven by AI and connectivity. The connectivity business, which includes Starlink, generated $5.25 billion in sales and $2.37 billion in operating profit.

Starlink ended September with 13.6 million consumer subscribers, up from 7.2 million a year earlier, positioning it as perhaps SpaceX's crown jewel. The company says its first revenue-generating Starship mission put roughly 10 times as much Starlink downlink capacity into orbit as a Falcon 9 Starlink launch.

Moreover, AI is already a massive business in terms of sales. SpaceX's Super Intelligence segment brought in $7.56 billion in the quarter, led by cloud agreements and the acquisition of AI coding company Cursor.

Story Continues

On the earnings call, Musk said the AI expansion implies "SpaceX annual recurring revenue by the end of 2027 is somewhere between $500 billion and $1 trillion."

Still, the AI segment's $16.4 billion in CapEx in Q3 alone is reason to temper that enthusiasm. The segment still has to show that the investment can pay off.

SpaceX wasn't the only big increase in Morgan Stanley's filing

Morgan Stanley doubled down on tech stocks in Q3 , and the reported share count rose by 7.43 million for Amazon, 5.68 million for Alphabet across both share classes, and 5.59 million for Nvidia. Microsoft and Meta went the other way.

The case for Amazon and Alphabet has everything to do with their tremendous cloud sales, despite elevated CapEx requirements. Amazon's AWS sales rose 39.3% in Q3 , and Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.7 billion . Those lofty figures show just how much customers are already paying for cloud capacity.

Nvidia sells the chips that power much of the AI buildout. However, as covered extensively, it's a rough time for the AI poster child following the ouster of its CEO, Jensen Huang. Nevertheless, it's still the front-runner in the AI space, and its upcoming quarterly report on Nov. 17 will offer more clues on where things go next.

What SpaceX stock investors should watch ahead

At its most recent close, SpaceX was worth an extraordinary $1.89 trillion, roughly 39 times forward sales estimates, as reported by Seeking Alpha .

That's a telling stat because a successful flight clearly strengthens the engineering case. At that valuation, though, I'd want the financial case to get stronger, too.

On the next earnings report, I'd watch Starlink subscriber growth and revenue per user together. More customers will mean a lot more to SpaceX if it can add them without cutting what each pays or spending disproportionately more to serve them.

Then it's important to look at cash. Through September, SpaceX generated $13.1 billion in operating cash flow and spent $48.1 billion on property, plant, and equipment, most of which is linked to its AI segment.

Cheaper satellite launches might help Starlink, but they can't settle whether the AI buildout earns its keep. Morgan Stanley's filing tells you where the shares were at quarter-end. Those operating numbers will tell you more about whether the stock is worth its price.

news.Title: Rocket from Boeing-Lockheed firm fails mid-flight, destroys payload of Amazon satellites
news.Content:
By Joey Roulette

Nov 15 (Reuters) - A Vulcan rocket owned by United Launch Alliance, the joint venture of Boeing and Lockheed Martin, failed on Sunday shortly after liftoff from Florida, destroying its payload of 40 satellites from Amazon's Leo internet network in the launch company's first mission failure.

The rocket failed ‌roughly 10 minutes after liftoff from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, and the cause was not immediately clear. It represented a major ‌setback for the two-decade-old company's new flagship rocket as ULA sought to begin a regular cadence of launches for Amazon's burgeoning satellite internet constellation.

"Based on data received by our Launch Director, we confirm that the Vulcan ​vehicle launched from Space Launch Complex 41 suffered an anomaly 10 minutes into the flight and failed to deliver the Amazon mission to orbit," ULA said in a statement.

"Every flight generates data, and every flight teaches us something. Since the anomaly just occurred, we don't have any specific data yet to understand what occurred today," ULA said.

The failure is expected to lead to a lengthy technical investigation that would keep the rocket off the market for months. This could deepen a US launch bottleneck brought on by other rocket mishaps and challenges across ‌the industry as well as the looming retirement of SpaceX's ⁠Falcon 9, the world's most active rocket. SpaceX is no longer accepting bookings for the Falcon 9.

"There is risk with any launch, and that's especially true for inaugural missions like LV-01," Amazon said in a statement, referring to the name of Sunday's mission. "ULA has been ⁠a trusted partner for Amazon, and we believe they'll learn from this mission and deliver on their long-term plans for Vulcan."

The Sunday flight was Vulcan's fifth since its 2024 debut and first in nine months, following a launch hiatus drawn out by separate technical investigations into its solid rocket side boosters and its core BE-4 engines, which are supplied by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos' Blue ​Origin ​space company.

Blue Origin is working with ULA in the investigation into Sunday's failure, according to a ​person familiar with the matter who spoke on condition of anonymity.

The ‌boosters were being scrutinized for issues encountered on Vulcan's last two flights, including a mission in February for the US Space Force. Both missions successfully delivered their payloads to orbit, but the Pentagon had not yet approved the rocket to resume flying national security payloads, pending its performance with the Amazon mission on Sunday.

Story Continues

Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket with the BE-4 engine had a launchpad explosion in May, and its investigation determined the engine was the cause. That led the company to modify those delivered to ULA for Vulcan, ULA spokesperson Jessica Rye told Reuters in August.

It was unclear if the BE-4 engines played a role in Sunday's mission failure. It appeared to occur after the separation of ‌Vulcan's second stage, the portion carrying the Amazon satellites, from the first-stage booster powered by the BE-4 ​engines.

ULA was formed in 2006 in a merger of Boeing's Delta rocket program and Lockheed Martin's Atlas ​rocket program. The company had embraced what was a 100% mission success record ​ever since. Its Delta and Atlas rockets had only suffered a handful of failures in the decades before the merger.

AMAZON'S ELUSIVE ACCESS TO ‌SPACE

The failure is another setback for Amazon as it races to ​deploy satellites using third-party launch providers, many of ​which have had groundings and failures. The New Glenn explosion in May happened days before it was due to launch Amazon Leo satellites.

The rocket failures have persistently held up Amazon's bid to rival SpaceX's vast Starlink internet network, which has more than 11,000 satellites and millions of customers worldwide.

SpaceX's wide lead over its ​satellite rivals is due in part to the advantage of ‌having its own rocket to launch its satellites, while other companies spend billions of dollars on external launches.

Since 2025, 398 Leo satellites have been deployed ​across 14 launches, about 12% of the 3,236 satellites Amazon needs for global service coverage. The company has hoped to start initial internet service ​this year.

(Reporting by Joey Roulette in Brownsville, Texas; Editing by Cynthia Osterman and Will Dunham)

news.Title: Is Meta Stock Still a Buy After Borrowing About $25 Billion This Month?
news.Content:
Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) has been raising money quickly. In late October, it priced a stock sale at $625 a share along with a sale of mandatory convertible preferred stock. Next, the social media company sold $15 billion in dollar bonds on Nov. 3 and €9 billion in euro bonds (around $10 billion) on Nov. 4. The euro deal was its first.

Meta borrowed about $25 billion this month. And the stock trades near $640 as I write, about 18% below its Sept. 24 closing high of about $778.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Is Meta stock still a buy with the extra debt? I think so, but the borrowing comes right before what might be Meta's most expensive quarter yet.

Image source: Getty Images.

What's the money for?

Meta said it plans to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes. Much of it will probably go toward the servers, data centers, and network infrastructure behind its capital spending.

Showing how quickly that spending has risen, Meta's capital expenditures (including principal payments on finance leases) climbed from $19.8 billion in the first three months of 2026 to $31.1 billion in the second quarter and $34.9 billion in the third quarter. Operating cash flow, meanwhile, stayed at around $32 billion to $33 billion every quarter. So, free cash flow (the cash left after capital spending) dropped from $12.4 billion in Q1 to $784 million in Q2 and then to negative $2.1 billion in Q3.

And the biggest spending quarter is probably still ahead. Management expects 2026 capital expenditures of $135 billion to $145 billion. With around $85.8 billion spent through September, the guidance points to another $49 billion to $59 billion by year-end.

If fourth-quarter operating cash flow comes in near the third quarter's $32.8 billion, Meta's spending could top it by about $16 billion to $26 billion. The new bonds raised around $25 billion after fees, plus about $14.3 billion from the preferred stock, which pays a 6.5% annual dividend.

Together, these amounts exceed a quarter's shortfall, and more is coming. Meta won't get the roughly $28.7 billion from its common stock sale until forward sale agreements settle, by Nov. 19, 2027, at the latest. Of course, management has said it plans to keep "investing aggressively" next year, too.

The interest bill is climbing but Meta can afford it

Story Continues

Meta owed $59 billion in notes at the end of 2025, and that face value rose to $84 billion by Sept. 30 after a $25 billion bond deal in May. This month's bonds bring it to around $109 billion.

Borrowing has gotten pricier, too. The new dollar notes pay interest rates of 5.85% (due 2031) to 7.5% (due 2056). Even the lowest beats the highest rate on any Meta bond sold before 2026, which was 5.75%.

The euro notes came in lower, at 4.3% to 6.4%, partly because benchmark interest rates in Europe sit below those in the U.S.

On Meta's third-quarter earnings call, chief financial officer Susan Li said the new Class C stock was part of a push "to ensure that we have access to a diverse pool of funding sources."

In the third quarter, Meta's interest expense more than quadrupled year over year to $977 million, and the new bonds add about $1.5 billion annually.

I think Meta can cover that bill. After all, it generated $22.9 billion in operating income in the third quarter alone, not counting a $9.89 billion legal charge. And Moody's still rates the debt Aa3 with a stable outlook, but S&P Global's AA- rating has a negative one.

Still a buy at about $640?

Meta's ad revenue, which pays for all this, climbed 26% year over year to $63.1 billion in the third quarter. Total revenue growth has slowed, from 33% in Q1 to 28% and then 26%. But management expects fourth-quarter revenue between $73 billion and $76 billion, indicating growth of about 22% to 27%.

And the stock doesn't look expensive. At roughly $640, Meta trades at about 18 times the earnings expected for 2027, near the 17.7 times forward earnings FactSet put on the S&P 500 on Nov. 5. So investors are paying about a market-average price for a company growing revenue over 20%.

Spending could outrun cash for longer than investors think, of course, and more borrowing at 6% to 7.5% could follow.

In the end, I think the extra debt is a fair cost for a business growing so fast, and the shares look worth buying around $640. I'd just want to see free cash flow go positive again once this round of spending peaks.

news.Title: Rigetti Computing vs. SoundHound AI: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.Content:
Investors often weigh the long-term potential of futuristic hardware against the more immediate scaling of software. Comparing Rigetti Computing (NASDAQ:RGTI) and SoundHound AI (NASDAQ:SOUN) highlights the choice between quantum hardware and conversational intelligence.

Rigetti is a pioneer in quantum computing, aiming to solve problems current computers cannot touch. SoundHound AI focuses on voice-enabled artificial intelligence, powering natural conversations in situations such as in-car commands and restaurant drive-through ordering. While both companies operate in the high-stakes world of emerging technology, their paths to commercial success follow very different trajectories.

The case for Rigetti Computing

Rigetti Computing builds superconducting quantum computers and operates them through its proprietary Quantum Cloud Services platform. The company sells access to its hardware to global enterprise and research clients, including partners like Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) and Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT). Nearly 90.2% of its revenue last year came from U.S. government contracts. Customer concentration like this adds a layer of risk to the business.

In the fiscal year ended Dec. 31, 2025, revenue reached nearly $7.1 million, which represented a decrease of 34.3% from the previous year. The company reported a net loss of $216.2 million, highlighting the high costs associated with developing its advanced technology roadmap.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the current ratio stood at 37.4x. The current ratio measures a company's ability to cover short-term debts with short-term assets, with a higher number suggesting more financial flexibility. Rigetti Computing carried a debt-to-equity ratio of zero at the end of last year, meaning it has essentially no total debt relative to its equity, though it reported free cash flow of negative $77.2 million for the year.

The case for SoundHound AI

SoundHound AI operates in the rapidly expanding market for voice-enabled tech stocks , serving major automotive manufacturers and diverse customer service sectors. It develops voice and agentic artificial intelligence software that powers natural conversational experiences for industries like automotive, retail, and hospitality. Following its acquisition of LivePerson, the business has integrated digital messaging and automation tools to broaden its customer reach.

In the fiscal year ended Dec. 31, 2025, revenue reached $168.9 million, marking a significant increase of 99.4% compared to the prior twelve-month period. This rapid growth was accompanied by a net loss of $14.0 million, which narrowed significantly from the prior year. The narrowing loss suggests the business is scaling its revenue at a much faster rate than its operating expenses.

Story Continues

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the current ratio stood at 4.6x, indicating a solid buffer for meeting short-term obligations. SoundHound AI maintained a debt-to-equity ratio of zero at the end of 2025, illustrating that total liabilities do not outweigh its shareholder equity. Free cash flow for the period was negative $103.1 million, as the company continues to invest heavily in acquisitions and platform development.

Risk profile comparison

Rigetti Computing faces significant hurdles related to its status as an early-stage hardware developer with a history of substantial operating losses. The business depends heavily on a small group of government customers, making it vulnerable to shifts in federal research budgets or policy changes. Furthermore, the company competes against massive, well-capitalized rivals such as IonQ (NYSE:IONQ) and D-Wave Quantum (NASDAQ:QBTS) in an industry where achieving quantum advantage -- the point when a quantum computer performs a computational task more efficiently and at lower cost than a classical computer -- is not guaranteed.

SoundHound AI deals with a history of substantial net losses and negative cash flow from operations. The company operates in a crowded market where incumbents like Microsoft and Amazon have vast resources to develop competing voice technologies. Additionally, SoundHound faces the complex task of integrating several major acquisitions while navigating evolving global regulations regarding artificial intelligence and data privacy.

Valuation comparison

On a P/S ratio basis, which measures market capitalization relative to sales over the past twelve months, SoundHound AI appears more reasonably valued than its peer.

Which stock would I buy for 2027?

Between Rigetti's potent quantum computers and SoundHound's artificial intelligence capabilities, I would invest in SoundHound for 2027. Several factors are key to that decision, the most important being the current state of quantum technology versus AI.

Quantum computers are still struggling to reach commercial viability. Rigetti management predicts quantum advantage is at least three years away. Moreover, the company's tech requires special cryogenic equipment that keeps its quantum particles at a state colder than outer space. That's expensive, adding a hurdle to broad adoption of its quantum computing tech. Rivals are producing quantum machines that can operate at room temperature, adding to Rigetti's competitive pressures.

SoundHound AI has been unprofitable for years, but that may change in 2027. In this year's third quarter report, the company announced it expects to reach adjusted EBITDA profitability by the second half of 2027.

Also, SoundHound has grown revenue consistently for years as it scales up customers, while Rigetti's sales are inconsistent due to the experimental nature of its technology, which does not lend itself to steady client adoption. SoundHound's Q3 revenue was $62.4 million, a 49% year-over-year increase, and it anticipates sales to hit at least $250 million in 2026, growing to a minimum of $350 million in 2027. The consistent revenue expansion, move to profitability, and superior share price valuation make SoundHound the better investment going into 2027.

news.Title: 《日股》AI買盤回補帶動 日經收漲0.53%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 16:24:22 數位內容中心 發佈

日股今(13)日收高，日經225指數收於61,142.35點，上漲322.99點或0.53%；東證股價指數(TOPIX)收於3,941.57點，上漲4.24點或0.11%。盤面一度由海外短線資金回補推升，日經225指數早盤曾強彈逾1,000點，但午後獲利了結與調節賣壓浮現，漲勢明顯收斂。

AI與半導體股方面，前一交易日承壓的AI、半導體相關股獲得買回，愛德萬測試(6857.JP)、東京威力科創(8035.JP)、Disco(6146.JP)等走勢偏強，帶動日經225指數早盤急漲。市場對NVIDIA執行長異動的擔憂降溫後，相關權值股迅速吸引資金回流，成為盤中最明顯的領漲主軸。

類股表現方面，服務、零售、倉儲與運輸、鐵路及紙漿造紙類股相對強勢，反映買盤偏向內需與部分運輸族群。非鐵金屬、機械及精密儀器類股則表現偏弱，顯示資金雖有回補，但並未全面擴散到所有產業類股。

個股表現方面，愛德萬測試、東京威力科創、Fast Retailing(9983.JP)、Recruit Holdings(6098.JP)、Konami Group(9766.JP)與Nintendo(7974.JP)走強，對指數形成支撐。軟銀集團(9984.JP)、Kioxia Holdings(285A.JP)、Terumo(4543.JP)等走弱，顯示部分大型權值與防衛相關個股仍有調節壓力。

《日股》買盤回流助強彈 日經收漲2.33%

《陸股》滬指漲0.1%，日K連二紅；科創50漲1.68%

news.Title: 黃仁勳請辭股市卻大漲？ 他見聯發科漲停超傻眼：不是該跌嗎
news.Content:
當科技巨頭陷入高層異動風暴，市場普遍預期相關供應鏈將難逃下殺命運，但盤面走勢卻往往打破散戶的直覺認知。近日一名股市新手透露，自己買在4600元的聯發科一度跌至3800元，原以為受輝達風波拖累會續探3400元，沒想到股價竟逆勢觸及漲停，引發熱烈探討。

輝達創辦人黃仁勳傳出辭職消息後，市場一度對整體AI產業前景產生動搖，然而IC設計大廠聯發科股價卻展現驚人韌性，盤中更逆勢強攻觸及漲停價位。一名今年3月才踏入台股的新手投資人在網路論壇 PTT 股票板上發文坦言，自己一個多月前以4600元的價格買進聯發科，隨後眼睜睜看著股價一路滑落至3800元，原本評估在輝達人事利空衝擊下，股價極可能進一步摜破3400元大關，未料開盤後不跌反漲，讓他當場看傻眼。

原PO進一步說明，事發前自己曾與身邊友人深入討論，當時一致認為縱使輝達人事對聯發科的直接業務衝擊有限，但整個AI族群在悲觀氛圍下恐怕都難逃補跌壓力，因此他早已抱定長期抗戰、套牢住套房的心理準備。豈料當天聯發科走勢完全背離預期、強勢噴出，讓他既驚喜又困惑，只好上網發問尋求高手客觀剖析背後的真正推手。

貼文曝光後，隨即引來大批股民熱烈回應，許多網友直接將這波逆勢大漲歸功於ASIC（客製化晶片）的轉單想像空間。留言區不少人直呼「ASIC崛起阿」，甚至有人直白表示「nv烙賽=asic出路變好」，分析一旦輝達未來的市場主導優勢出現鬆動，各大雲端服務供應商勢必會加快自行研發晶片的腳步，進而讓具備客製化晶片設計實力的聯發科獲得更多資金青睞。

此外，也有部分網友將焦點鎖定在Google的TPU布局，留言指出「Google陣營的，預期TPU會起來」，同時連帶點名創意、世芯等相關IC設計服務業者，看好客製化晶片有機會進一步瓜分傳統GPU的部分應用市占率。不過，市場人士也提醒，這類說法多半反映投資人對產業版圖洗牌的預期心理，尚無法直接證實聯發科單日的漲停走勢全數由單一消息所驅動。

另一派網友則認為，短線股價的劇烈波動未必非得套上基本面理由，有人直言「就是炒作而已啦想太多」，更有人語重心長地提醒新手「老師有沒有跟你講不要看新聞做股票」。不少留言也指出，股市走勢向來愛與大眾直覺唱反調，單憑輝達高層消息就一竿子打翻所有AI概念股，顯然忽略了GPU與ASIC兩大陣營在產業鏈中既競爭又消長的微妙關係。

（封面示意圖／東森新聞資料照）

news.Title: 美元指數高檔回落與台股反彈，新台幣週五帶量升值5.1分收32.838元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】台股週五(13日)反彈，美元指數自約19個月高點小幅回落，新台幣兌美元終場升值5.1分，收報32.838元。銀行間匯市成交金額為22億1,400萬美元，遠高於前一交易日的16億5,100萬美元。新台幣週五以32.870元開出，早盤最低下探32.920元，午後最強觸及32.827元，全日高低相差9.3分。同日，台股加權指數收漲583.25點或1.35%，報43,675.12點，早盤一度強升至44,489.48點，惟連兩日遭遇賣壓襲擊，尾盤漲幅收斂。

美元指數週四一度觸及103.242，為2025年4月以來最高，週五亞洲時段小幅回落，仍徘徊在高點附近。美國通膨高於預期，市場持續評估聯準會(Fed)12月升息幅度，以及利率可能維持高檔的時間，美元仍有支撐。

新台幣週五雖隨台股反彈，但今年以來在主要亞幣中仍相對偏弱。以去年底31.438元與週五收盤32.838元換算，新台幣兌美元今年以來貶值約4.3%，同期人民幣兌美元則升值近5%。

news.Title: 輝達人事震撼持續發酵，道瓊歐洲50指數早盤下跌0.3%，主要指數全面開低
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】歐洲股市週五早盤主要指數全面陷入拉回格局，道瓊歐洲50指數開盤下跌0.3%，德國DAX指數跌0.5%，英國富時100指數跌0.2%，法國CAC 40指數同步跌0.2%。市場人士指出，除了總體經濟數據與地緣政治變數干擾外，投資人持續消化跨國科技巨擘的重大人事地震，氣氛顯得相對謹慎保守。在美股科技板塊方面，人工智慧晶片巨擘輝達(Nvidia)共同創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳日前閃電請辭的衝擊持續在市場發酵。儘管美股盤中曾吸引大舉散户資金進場承接，但面對高層人事動盪與美國司法部後續調查的潛在不確定性，輝達盤後交易仍面臨持續追低壓力，進一步牽動全球半導體與科技股的投資信心。

歐股盤面上，各類股普遍呈現震盪整理。投資人正密切關注歐美央行接下來的貨幣政策走向，以及中東地緣衝突對能源成本與供應鏈帶來的實質影響。各大機構法人普遍建議，在跨國科技巨頭領導層更迭與總經數據不明朗之際，短線資金操作宜保持審慎，嚴控持股風險。

news.Title: 央行明年繳庫逾2200億　外資持有台股占比大增恐影響上繳數
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘姿羽台北2026年11月13日電）立院財政委員會16日審查中央銀行116年度預算，書面報告今天出爐，116年度央行繳庫數為新台幣2200億4828萬元，連4年突破2000億元大關，並續寫99年以來最高紀錄。不過央行指出，外資持股市值大幅攀升，牽動央行調節策略，恐影響未來營收及繳庫。

央行每年為國庫賺進大把鈔票，素有「國庫金雞母」的稱號。根據書面報告，央行116年度預算繳交國庫官息紅利，全數列為行政院歲入預算，共計2200億4828萬元，較115年度預算繳庫數增加200億元，主因是預計115年營業收入較往年提高，奉行政院核定，115年度累積盈餘保留至116年度繳庫部分增加所致。

細看央行營業總收入，央行（含中央造幣廠、中央印製廠）116年度預算營業總收入為4464億元，較115年度預算數增加176億元，成長率為4.11%。央行收入結構以利息收入為大宗，利息收入4121億元，包括投資國內外各類證券利息、存放國內外銀行利息及各項融通利息等收入。

不過央行強調，央行以穩定物價及促進金融穩定為主要營運目標，營運特性須考量總體經濟面，且盈餘受國內外金融情勢影響甚鉅，具有高度不確定性。

央行說明，外幣資產運用收益是央行營業收入主要來源，影響收益的各項因素，包括營運量、主要外幣利率及匯率，均非央行能完全掌握；營業支出則受央行沖銷性措施以及國內利率調整變動影響，同樣具有不確定性，這也是各國央行面臨的問題。

值得注意的是，央行此次特別點出，基於穩定匯市、預留貨幣政策空間的考量，可能影響未來營收及繳庫能力。

央行表示，從收入面而言，外資持有國內股票市值大幅上升，為了維護對內及對外幣值穩定，央行須適時進場調節，外匯存底未必能持續成長，可能影響央行未來營收及繳庫數。

支出面而言，央行滾動式調整國內通膨預測值，致力達成維持物價與金融穩定目標，因此需考量預留執行貨幣政策的空間。

news.Title: 《台股盤後》收漲583點、44K得而復失；週K翻紅
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-13 16:05:36 新聞中心 發佈

台股今(13)日早盤由台積電、聯發科領軍強攻，一度大漲近1,400點、重新站回44000點大關，惟市場對「黃仁勳衝擊」的後續影響評估見分歧，同時NASDAQ電子盤在亞股盤中也翻黑，一定程度影響市場信心，加權指數盤中漲幅趨於收斂，不過，在ASIC族群整齊強攻、金控及玻陶及塑膠股明顯助攻，且主要AI權值股僅欣興、廣達收黑下，終場上漲583.25點或1.35%、收在43675.12點，量縮至9162.55億元；週K線翻紅，本週共計上漲3973.48點或10.01%。

黃仁勳火速辭去輝達執行長職務、輝達跌逾4%，且衝擊新型雲端服務商(Neocloud)等概念股走跌，加上美國10年公債殖利率重返5%、美元指數因大環境不確定性再揚升，導致週四美股四大指數皆收黑、並以費半指數下跌0.54%表現最差。亞洲股市方面，因日股已先行在昨日反映「黃仁勳衝擊」，買盤回籠，半導體相關股走揚，日經225指數終場收漲0.53%；韓國KOSPI指數則走低，下跌0.98%。

今日權王台積電早盤最高觸及2390元，隨後拉回至平盤附近上下震盪，終場以2350元作收，上漲0.43%，奇鋐飆漲逾9%，大立光、緯穎、台光電、日月光投控等電子權值股連袂走揚，惟健策、川湖逆勢下跌逾4%、3%。另外，因黃仁勳請辭事件，市場看好ASIC有望加速發展，激勵聯發科股價重返4000元關卡、終場收漲逾7%，且同概念題材的創意、世芯-KY也雙雙勁揚逾9%。

從29大類股表現來看，以數位雲端類股漲幅7.98%居冠，玻璃陶瓷類股漲4.00%，塑膠類股也漲3.85%，成為盤面前三大強勢類股。弱勢族群方面，鋼鐵類股跌勢最重、收跌1.85%，其次依序為綠能環保、造紙類股，分別下跌1.68%、1.50%。

三大法人動向方面，今日三大法人合計買超439.66億元；其中，自營商買超68.92億元，投信買超82.37億元，外資及陸資買超288.37億元。

《台股盤後》飆漲1545點，重返44K及十日線

news.Content:

Waste Management（WM.US）

11月10日，Waste Management推出全美回收教育倡議「I Recycle」，並在11月15日America Recycles Day前擴大宣傳，主打社區參與與「I Recycle Pledge」。公司援引對1,146名美國成人的調查指出，4分之3表示有回收，近半數正主動尋找更多回收方式。

Casella Waste Systems（CWST.US）

Casella Waste Systems於2026年第三季顯示量增未必帶動獲利同步擴張；當季營收年增15.2%至5.592億美元，但調整後EBITDA利潤率下滑80個基點至23.9%。這次訊號更接近循環設施整合與資產配置壓力，而非單純處理量擴張。

news.Title: AI投資未退潮而是大分散！資金轉出輝達 超微、博通與台積電成潛在受惠者
news.Content: 輝達(NVDA-US)領導層危機，正為主要競爭對手及合作夥伴創造機會，從超微(AMD-US)、博通(AVGO-US)到合作夥伴台積電(TSM-US)(2330-TW)，都可能成為這場動盪的受惠者。 投資人正在押注，黃仁勳離開後，長期主導AI晶片產業的輝達對整個產業的掌控力可能因此鬆動。宏利投資管理亞洲多元資產解決方案主管Mark Franklin說：「目前市場出現的情況，是資金稍微轉向其他先進晶片設計公司，投資人假設這將讓其他公司有機會迎頭趕上。」 資金輪動之際，黃仁勳周四(12日)已請辭下台，他被揭露涉及多段婚外情，其中一名女性被美國情報界認為是中國間諜。 Franklin指出，黃仁勳離開可能讓競爭對手有機會縮小差距，尤其輝達目前正面臨領導層不確定性。這波資金輪動也已帶動其他半導體股走勢轉強。 瑞穗美國(Mizuho Americas)股票交易執行董事Farzin Azam表示，從交易部門的觀察也能看出這項轉變，投資人正轉向較不受輝達管理層動盪影響的晶片業者，「像台積電、博通、超微這些公司，都可能成為這波變局的贏家，因為它們沒有管理層變動帶來的負面因素。」 輝達股價本周迄今重挫11%，競爭對手超微與博通則分別上漲30%及24%。 為輝達生產最先進處理器的台積電，同期股價上漲11%，因為無論最後是哪家晶片設計業者勝出或失利，台積電都有望受惠。當投資人撤出被視為風險較高的AI概念股時，台積電受到仍看好AI產業趨勢、但希望承擔相對較低風險的投資人青睞。 Azam指出，這波資金輪動也擴及半導體產業中投機性較低的領域，包括德州儀器(TXN-US)、亞德諾半導體(Analog Devices)(ADI-US)及德國英飛凌(Infineon)等類比晶片製造商，反映投資人正採取較防禦性的布局。 德儀本周股價上漲約13%，亞德諾半導體與英飛凌分別上漲12%及14%。 輝達主導地位鬆動 除了市場短期反應，半導體研究機構SemiAnalysis執行長Dylan Patel認為，黃仁勳離開可能從根本改變AI供應鏈的競爭態勢。 Patel表示，黃仁勳長期以來親自與製造商及零組件供應商建立關係，協助輝達搶先競爭對手取得產能。如今隨著Google(GOOGL-US)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)等公司積極擴大AI晶片產量，輝達的這項優勢可能面臨挑戰。 Patel指出，這兩家大型雲端服務業者原本就快速拉近與輝達在掌握供應鏈產能方面的差距，黃仁勳不再能影響供應商後，兩家公司可能加快相關布局。 Patel表示：「如果輝達無法掌握供應鏈，那麼技術就是唯一的競爭優勢。但沒有黃仁勳，他們還能維持技術領先嗎？考量到他們只領先最大競爭對手一年，差距其實並不大。」 在大型雲端服務業者愈來愈積極開發自有AI晶片，以降低對輝達的依賴之際，這項挑戰尤其迫切。與此同時，超微及其他半導體公司也正競相爭取更大的市場占有率。 然而，這場動盪並不意味著整體AI投資熱潮即將結束。Franklin認為，科技巨頭2027年仍將擴大AI支出，2028年也可能持續成長，這代表整體投資周期仍有結構性力量支撐。

news.Title: 黃仁勳閃辭台灣恐失去「直通川普王牌」！1大咖有望成接班人
news.Content: 財經中心／綜合報導 晶片巨頭輝達（NVIDIA）創辦人黃仁勳閃辭總裁、執行長與董事三項職務，引發全球關注，擔心這場高層地震是否波及台灣半導體供應鏈與總部計畫。對此，美國聖湯瑪斯大學國際研究講座教授葉耀元分析，認為黃仁勳離開後，輝達與台積電的合作及台北總部計畫都不會受影響，真正最大的衝擊在於外交與政治層面，台灣少了一個能夠「直通」美國總統川普的重要發聲管道，未來這項重責大任恐怕得交棒給「這1半導體大咖」。 輝達創辦人黃仁勳閃辭總裁、執行長與董事三項職務。（圖／民視新聞網） 針對外界擔憂輝達「群龍無首」恐衝擊台灣產業，葉耀元在臉書粉專《葉教授的國際事務學院》 發文 提出深度剖析。他直言，黃仁勳有沒有繼續掌握輝達，其實並不會影響到輝達與台灣晶片產業、也就是台積電之間的緊密合作，同時也不會改變輝達總部是否仍然設在台北的既定布局。 葉耀元強調，台積電先進製程晶片對輝達而言至關重要，沒有任何事情可以輕易撼動彼此之間的堅實夥伴關係。此外，輝達上上下下的高階領導階層，長期以來都對台灣具備足夠的熟悉度，因此就算黃仁勳卸下所有職務，整體而言也不應該會影響到輝達與台灣的實質商業關係。 超微執行長蘇姿丰。（圖／AMD） 然而，產業鏈雖然穩固，政治與白宮溝通管道卻出現變數。葉耀元點出目前對台灣而言比較大的實質影響，在於黃仁勳過去擁有能夠「直通」美國總統川普的特殊地位與分量；如今當黃仁勳不再坐在輝達總裁與執行長的位子上，華府決策圈就少了一個極具影響力、可以隨時跟川普討論台灣議題的關鍵人物。葉耀元在文末也點名另一位出身台灣的半導體女王，直言或許接下來要靠「超微（AMD）執行長蘇姿丰」來接下這個重責大任，繼續在美國政商界為台灣發聲。

news.Title: 外資回頭大買288億！聯發科、創意領軍猛攻　台股近千家上漲
news.Content:
台股今（13）日氣勢如虹強力反攻，加權指數終場上漲583.25點，收在43675.12點，漲幅1.35%，成交金額為9162.55億元；主攻中小型股也跟著走高，櫃買指數終場上漲6.68點，收在342.41點，漲幅1.99%，成交金額2208.12億元。三大法人合計買超逾439.65億元，外資及陸資、自營商與投信同步站上買方。

外資回頭大買288億　台股近千家上漲

細看三大法人動向，外資及陸資（不含外資自營商）買超288.37億元，投信買超82.37億元，自營商合計買超68.92億元。其中自營商（自行買賣）買超42.99億元，自營商（避險）買超25.94億元。

上市個股方面，上漲家數達983家、下跌僅293家，漲停28家、跌停3家，多方明顯握有主導權。再看成交值居前的權值股，台積電（2330）依舊是穩盤要角，終場上漲10元，收在2350元，漲幅0.43%，漲勢雖然溫和，仍替大盤撐起一道防線。聯發科（2454）則是全場焦點，股價勁揚270元，收在4120元，漲幅7.01%，成為帶動電子權值股回溫的指標。

高價電子股部分，創意（3443）飆漲750元，收在8610元，漲幅高達9.54%，氣勢強悍；台達電（2308）收在1240元，持平震盪，走勢相對沉穩。另外，台玻（1802）上漲3.4元，收在85.1元，漲幅4.16%；南亞（1303）上漲11元，收在304元，漲幅3.75%；富喬（1815）上漲5元，收在142元，漲幅3.65%，可見買盤不只集中在大型電子股，部分傳產與材料股也同樣獲得資金青睞。

投資一定有風險，基金投資有賺有賠，申購前應詳閱公開說明書。

news.Title: 高盛估標普500明年底上看8700點，美股牛市延續並加碼評等日股
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】國際金融巨擘高盛(Goldman Sachs)發布最新跨市戰略法人報告指出，儘管企業獲利增速預期將自高檔放緩，但在估值理性回落、債券殖利率、油價與全球通膨壓力同步趨於緩和的有利宏觀環境下，美股多頭牛市將一路延續至2027年。由彼得·奧本海默(Peter Oppenheimer)領軍的高盛策略團隊預測，未來12個月標普500指數將穩步攀升至8,700點，對應約14%的價格收益率與16%的總收益率。在企業基本面與獲利預期方面，高盛團隊預估標普500企業的每股盈餘(EPS)增速將從2026年的36%，放緩至2027年的11%。儘管成長動能趨緩，但隨著科技板塊先前歷經顯著的估值修正與技術性回檔，高盛明確表示看好美國大型雲端運算服務商(Hyperscalers)的長線競爭力，並建議投資人聚焦成長股、精選防禦型板塊，以及受惠於債券殖利率與油價下行的潛在標的。不過，報告也同步提示潛在風險，包括人工智慧(AI)資本開支增速放緩、債市與油價波動加劇，以及市場高度集中度問題，都可能在行情推進過程中引發短期震盪。

在區域資產配置方面，高盛對日本股市給予高度肯定的「超配(Overweight)」評等。報告預估東證指數(TOPIX)目標位上看4,500點，對應15%的價格收益率與17%的總收益率，預期日本企業在2027年的每股收益增速可望維持在9%的穩健水準，展現出強韌的企業治理改革紅利與出口競爭力。

news.Title: 台股蒸發萬點也不怕 8檔人氣ETF定期定額戶數逆勢增
news.Content:
MSCI 12日公布最新半年度調整，台股權重在三大指數同獲調升，但此利多消息尚未能收復台股10月失土，總計加權指數這波下跌，自史上高點至谷底蒸發12000點，跌幅達24%；但同一時間的台股ETF，受益人依舊持續創高，較前一月增加136萬人，吸引最多人定期定額投資的10檔ETF，更有8檔交易戶數較9月底成長，顯見投資人無畏盤勢下跌，越跌越買。

綜觀定期定額交易戶數逆勢成長的8檔台股ETF，近半年交易戶數全面呈現成長，更有5檔戶數成長幅度達雙位數以上，包括凱基台灣TOP50(009816-TW)、群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)、國泰台灣科技龍頭(00881-TW)、元大台灣50(0050-TW)，以及元大高股息(0056-TW)，其中凱基台灣TOP50(009816-TW)人氣全壘打，不只最近六個月定期定額交易戶數月月成長，半年來更成長了77.69%，成為定期定額人氣榜上的當紅炸子雞。

市場法人表示，投資人買盤力道強勁，不僅上半年台股多頭氣盛時持續買進，即便盤勢開始進入震盪格局，買盤力道也不見消退；定期定額做為長線投資風向球，從人氣ETF在大盤逆風時期人數依舊看漲，就可以看出投資人對台股後市深具信心，市場雜音引發的回檔反而成為投資人進場布局的良機。

凱基台灣TOP50(009816)ETF研究團隊表示，2027年資料中心訂單已定案，台廠訂單能見度高，台廠 AI 基礎建設與晶片供應鏈布局既深且廣，可望持續受惠AI需求暢旺，近期的CSP大廠現金流疑慮與單一公司治理等AI市場雜音，不致改變AI算力需求持續擴張的方向，較可能促使AI晶片市場加速走向多元化，預期資金加速輪動下，建議投資人透過市值型ETF分散單壓風險，一舉網羅台股50強企業成長契機，並以定期定額分散進場時間風險，拉長投資期間，用時間複利累積財富。

news.Title: 外資終於回頭！ 台股大漲583點 三大法人買超439億
news.Content:
台股今（13）日上演狂飆千點後收斂行情！受到買盤強力挹注，加權指數早盤一度狂飆1397.61點，重新站上4萬4千點，不過午盤過後賣壓出籠，漲幅明顯收斂，終場上漲583.25點，收在43675.12點，漲幅1.35%，成交量達9162.55億元。本週累計大漲3973.48點，週漲幅達10.01%，終結週線連4黑。《台大批踢踢》網友看到法人動向直呼「外資竟然買超」，也有人好奇：「到底誰在賣？」

三大法人今日同步站在買方，合計買超439.65億元，其中外資及陸資終結連續11個交易日賣超，轉為買超288.36億元；投信持續加碼82.36億元，寫下連續24個交易日買超紀錄；自營商也由賣轉買，買超68.92億元。外資大舉回頭買進，成為今日盤面重要支撐。

進一步觀察投信個股買賣超，買超前5名依序為中信金（2891）、富邦金（2881）、國泰金（2882）、南亞（1303）及長榮（2603），金融股包辦前三名，顯示投信持續布局金融族群。賣超前5名則為聯電（2303）、台新新光金（2887）、凱基金（2883）、玉山金（2884）及元大金（2885），金融股同時出現在買賣兩側，投信操作呈現個別調整。

法人買盤回籠，也讓PTT股民議論紛紛，有網友看到外資轉買，驚呼「太神啦，外資那行終於不是綠色的了」，還有人笑稱「小兒終於回頭」、「外資回頭，散戶剛好倒貨」。不過，也有網友對盤勢漲幅收斂感到疑惑，連續追問「誰在賣？」甚至有人認為散戶恐慌出場，讓法人趁勢接貨。另有網友提醒，外資買超不代表行情就此反轉，後續仍要觀察法人能否延續買盤力道。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 台股千點攻勢收斂仍漲逾500點，ASIC三強扮多頭焦點，豐達科見轉強
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股週五開盤不久即大漲逾千點，但上午10點過後賣壓逐漸湧現，午間指數漲幅明顯收斂，終場上漲583.25點，以43,675.12點作收，成交量略為縮減至約9,162億元，顯示市場追價力道仍有待觀察。　　盤面上，ASIC相關族群成為短線焦點，聯發科(2454)、創意(3443)及世芯-KY(3661)等指標股，雖然午後陸續打開漲停板，但整體股價仍維持強勢型態，顯示資金對自研AI晶片及ASIC產業趨勢的認同度仍高。因此，台股短線能否進一步向上攻堅，可先觀察聯發科、創意及世芯-KY等指標股能否延續強勢，並帶動相關族群接棒表態。

此外，隨著第三季財報陸續公布，市場不少個股不僅本益比具吸引力，營收、業績及獲利更同步創高，股價漸獲投資人青睞，豐達科(3004)便是其中代表。豐達科週五股價重新站回各條均線之上，技術面已有轉強跡象，若後續成交量能進一步放大，將有助於股價延續反彈，朝更高位置挑戰。

news.Title: ASIC軍團點火！聯發科、創意噴漲停 台股收漲583點
news.Content:
台股今（13）日開高震盪，盤中一度大漲逾1300點，不過後續漲勢收斂，44000點得而復失，尾盤以43675點作收，上漲583點，漲幅1.35%，成交量來到9162億元，資金聚焦於Google概念股、台塑四寶等。
